/// Open/close animation profile of a gooey toast.
enum GooeyToastAnimationStyle { sileo, smooth, snappy, bouncy, fluid, springEasing }
/// Corner profile of the gooey silhouette.
enum GooeyToastShapeStyle { defaultShape, soft, sharp, capsule }
/// Animation profile of the expanded body content.
enum GooeyToastBodyAnimationStyle { fade, fadeSlide, fadeScale, none }
/// Fixed status tones: the reference gooey-toast hues, tuned so every one of
/// them clears 3:1 against BOTH the light and the dark `popover` fill.
///
/// upstream ships no success/warning/info tokens, and the chart tokens change hue
/// per preset and mode (success read blue in dark, orange in light), so the
/// status tones are fixed constants instead of token references: the same
/// green, red, amber, blue, indigo and grey in every mode and preset.
/// [ensureToneContrast] (in `gooey_toast_options.dart`) still lifts a tone that
/// is too weak for a customised surface, so a user-chosen fill stays readable
/// without anyone re-checking the palette.
const Color gooeySuccessTone = Color(0xFF16A34A);
/// Fixed warning tone; see [gooeySuccessTone].
const Color gooeyWarningTone = Color(0xFFB45309);
/// Fixed info tone; see [gooeySuccessTone].
const Color gooeyInfoTone = Color(0xFF3B82F6);
/// Fixed action tone; see [gooeySuccessTone].
const Color gooeyActionTone = Color(0xFF6366F1);
/// Fixed loading tone; see [gooeySuccessTone].
const Color gooeyLoadingTone = Color(0xFF6B7280);
/// Fixed error tone; a static red (like the other status tones) so the error
/// colour is identical in every preset and clears 3:1 on the light surface —
/// the `destructive` token flips to a pale red in dark mode that is unreadable
/// on the light toast. See [gooeySuccessTone].
const Color gooeyErrorTone = Color(0xFFDC2626);
/// Surface fill: main's light near-white, inverted from the dark site so the
/// toast reads as a light card in dark mode. A fixed value (not a token) so the
/// silhouette colour is stable across presets and modes, like the reference;
/// user-overridable through the component theme.
const Color gooeySurfaceFill = Color(0xFFF7F8FA);
/// Compact title style before the state tone is applied.
const TextStyle gooeyTitleTextStyle = TextStyle(fontSize: 13.2, height: 1.0, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500);
/// Expanded description style; the colour comes from [GooeyToastTheme]
/// `descriptionColor` (resolved per build), so it stays null here.
const TextStyle gooeyDescriptionTextStyle = TextStyle(fontSize: 14, height: 1.43, fontWeight: FontWeight.w400);
/// Visual and timing contract of a gooey toast.
///
/// Every field is nullable: an override leg sets only what it changes and
/// [merge] keeps the lower leg's remaining fields. The six `*Tone` fields are
/// direct (Studio-editable) theme fields, so a customised toast keeps its
/// identity across presets instead of following a token that changes hue.
class GooeyToastTheme extends ComponentThemeData implements Mergeable<GooeyToastTheme> {
  const GooeyToastTheme({super.themeDensity, super.themeSpacing, super.themeShadows, this.width, this.fill, this.roundness, this.titleStyle, this.descriptionStyle, this.descriptionColor, this.duration, this.animationStyle, this.shapeStyle, this.bodyAnimationStyle, this.enableGooeyBlur, this.compactMorph, this.successTone, this.loadingTone, this.errorTone, this.warningTone, this.infoTone, this.actionTone});
  double? width;
/// Surface fill. Default: main's light near-white (#F7F8FA), inverted from
/// the dark site background so the toast reads as a light card.
  ThemedColor? fill;
  double? roundness;
/// Compact title style; null uses `gooeyTitleTextStyle` in the state tone.
  TextStyle? titleStyle;
/// Expanded description style; null uses `gooeyDescriptionTextStyle`.
  TextStyle? descriptionStyle;
/// Expanded description colour, applied when the style carries none.
/// Default: the `mutedForeground` token.
  ThemedColor? descriptionColor;
  Duration? duration;
  GooeyToastAnimationStyle? animationStyle;
  GooeyToastShapeStyle? shapeStyle;
  GooeyToastBodyAnimationStyle? bodyAnimationStyle;
  bool? enableGooeyBlur;
/// Compact pill morph profile for in-place title/state changes.
  GooeyCompactMorph? compactMorph;
/// `success` accent. Default: the fixed [gooeySuccessTone] green.
  ThemedColor? successTone;
/// `loading` accent. Default: the fixed [gooeyLoadingTone] grey.
  ThemedColor? loadingTone;
/// `error` accent. Default: the fixed [gooeyErrorTone] red.
  ThemedColor? errorTone;
/// `warning` accent. Default: the fixed [gooeyWarningTone] amber.
  ThemedColor? warningTone;
/// `info` accent. Default: the fixed [gooeyInfoTone] blue.
  ThemedColor? infoTone;
/// `action` accent. Default: the fixed [gooeyActionTone] indigo.
  ThemedColor? actionTone;
/// Returns a copy with the given fields replaced.
  GooeyToastTheme copyWith({ValueGetter<double?>? width, ValueGetter<ThemedColor?>? fill, ValueGetter<double?>? roundness, ValueGetter<TextStyle?>? titleStyle, ValueGetter<TextStyle?>? descriptionStyle, ValueGetter<ThemedColor?>? descriptionColor, ValueGetter<Duration?>? duration, ValueGetter<GooeyToastAnimationStyle?>? animationStyle, ValueGetter<GooeyToastShapeStyle?>? shapeStyle, ValueGetter<GooeyToastBodyAnimationStyle?>? bodyAnimationStyle, ValueGetter<bool?>? enableGooeyBlur, ValueGetter<GooeyCompactMorph?>? compactMorph, ValueGetter<ThemedColor?>? successTone, ValueGetter<ThemedColor?>? loadingTone, ValueGetter<ThemedColor?>? errorTone, ValueGetter<ThemedColor?>? warningTone, ValueGetter<ThemedColor?>? infoTone, ValueGetter<ThemedColor?>? actionTone});
/// First-non-null-wins merge; the receiver (higher-priority leg) wins.
  GooeyToastTheme merge(GooeyToastTheme? fallback);
/// Colours, styles and flags step at `t < 0.5`; dimensions interpolate.
  static GooeyToastTheme lerp(GooeyToastTheme a, GooeyToastTheme b, double t);
  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;
}

class GooeyToastPayload {

  String id;

  Object? stateTag;
  String title;
  String? description;
  GooeyToastState state;
  GooeyToastPosition position;

  Widget? expandedChild;

  ThemedColor fill;
  ValueChanged<bool>? onExpansionChanged;

  ToastPlacement get placement;

  bool get expandUp;
/// Whether the expanded body has anything to show.
  bool get hasBody;
/// Copies with the given fields replaced; a nullable field is wiped only when
/// it is explicitly passed as `null`, so `replace(description: null)` clears
/// it while `replace()` keeps everything.
  GooeyToastPayload replace({Object? stateTag = _kUnset, String? title, GooeyToastState? state, Duration? duration, Object? description = _kUnset, Object? expandedChild = _kUnset, Object? action = _kUnset, Object? autopilot = _kUnset, Object? onExpansionChanged = _kUnset, GooeyCompactMorph? compactMorph, bool? persistUntilDismissed});
}
/// One live toast: its overlay entry, payload notifier and countdown state.
class GooeyToastRecord {
/// Creates a record.
  GooeyToastRecord({required this.id, required this.entry, required this.data, required this.updatedAt});
/// Stable toast id.
  String id;
/// Inserted overlay entry.
  OverlayEntry entry;
/// Mutable payload driving overlay rebuilds.
  ValueNotifier<GooeyToastPayload> data;
/// Last mutation timestamp, used for region ordering (newest first).
  DateTime updatedAt;
/// Countdown timer while the toast is not interacting.
  Timer? dismissTimer;
/// Remaining lifetime while paused by hover/press.
  Duration? remaining;
/// When the running countdown started.
  DateTime? dismissStartedAt;
/// Whether pointer interaction is active.
  bool interacting;
/// Monotonic token invalidating stale transition callbacks.
  int transitionToken;
/// Timers driving staged transitions.
  List<Timer> transitionTimers;
/// Cancels the staged transition timers.
  void cancelTransitionTimers();
/// Releases the entry and every timer.
  void dispose();
}

/// Owns the gooey toasts of a layer and renders them into the root overlay.
class GooeyToastController extends ChangeNotifier {
/// Creates a controller.
  GooeyToastController();
/// Active toasts, newest first.
  List<GooeyToastDetails> get activeToasts;
/// Whether a toast with [id] is active.
  bool containsToast(String id);
/// Dismisses the toast with [id], if present.
  void dismiss(String id);
/// Pauses or resumes the countdown of the toast [id].
///
/// Pausing keeps the remaining lifetime, so a toast hovered for half its
/// duration still shows for the other half once the pointer leaves.
  void setInteracting(String id, bool value);
/// Shows a gooey toast and returns its id.
///
/// [behavior] decides what happens when the slot is already occupied;
/// `transition` reuses the live record so the pill morphs between states
/// instead of being torn down (the promise and multi-state flows).
  String showGooeyToast(BuildContext context, GooeyToastOptions options, {String? id, GooeyToastNewToastBehavior? behavior, Duration? duration, bool autoDismiss = true, VoidCallback? onDismissed});
  void dispose();

/// Builds the overlay entry of the toast [toastId].
///
/// The entry is rebuilt whenever the controller marks it dirty (a new toast, a
/// dismiss, a transition) and whenever the payload notifier changes.
OverlayEntry gooeyToastEntry(String toastId, {required GooeyToastRecord? Function(String id) recordOf, required int Function(String id, ToastPlacement placement) indexOf, required GooeyToastController controller});
/// Semantic state of a gooey toast; picks the default icon and tone.
enum GooeyToastState { success, loading, error, warning, info, action }
/// Blends [tone] toward [foreground] until its contrast on [surface] reaches
/// [minRatio] (3:1, the non-text UI floor).
///
/// Returns [tone] untouched when it already passes, so stable tones stay
/// identical across modes and presets; returns [foreground] when no blend
/// passes (a surface too close to the tone in both directions).
Color ensureToneContrast(Color tone, {required Color surface, required Color foreground, double minRatio = 3});
/// Horizontal anchor of a gooey toast.
enum GooeyToastPosition { left, center, right }
/// Vertical growth direction of the expanded body.
enum GooeyToastExpandDirection { bottom, top }
/// Strategy when a new toast is shown in an occupied slot.
enum GooeyToastNewToastBehavior { stack, dismissPrevious, transition }
/// Auto expand/collapse policy of a shown toast.
///
/// Delays are relative to when the toast appears (expand) and when it opens
/// (collapse). `Duration.zero` expands immediately or disables the collapse
/// schedule; a null autopilot disables both, leaving expansion to hover, press
/// and tap only.
class GooeyAutopilot {
/// Creates an autopilot policy.
  const GooeyAutopilot({this.expandDelay = const Duration(milliseconds: 150), this.collapseDelay = const Duration(milliseconds: 4000)});
/// Delay before the body expands after the toast appears.
  Duration? expandDelay;
/// Delay before the body collapses back once it has expanded.
  Duration? collapseDelay;
/// Delay before auto-expansion starts.
  Duration get resolvedExpandDelay;
/// Delay before auto-collapse starts.
  Duration get resolvedCollapseDelay;
}
/// Inline action shown in the expanded body.
class GooeyToastAction {
/// Creates an action.
  const GooeyToastAction({required this.label, required this.onPressed});
  String label;
  VoidCallback onPressed;
}
/// Content and behaviour of one gooey toast.
///
/// The toast lifecycle is: enter as a compact pill, morph open after the
/// autopilot expand delay, stay expanded until the collapse delay, collapse
/// back to the pill, then leave when the `duration` expires (6s by default).
/// Hover, press or focus pauses the countdown; swipe in the slot's dismiss
/// direction, the close button, Escape while focused, or
/// `GooeyToastController.dismiss` dismisses early. A `loading` toast never
/// expands; show one, await the work, then show the settled state with
/// [GooeyToastNewToastBehavior.transition] for the promise pattern.
class GooeyToastOptions {
/// Creates toast options.
  const GooeyToastOptions({required this.title, this.description, this.state = GooeyToastState.success, this.position = GooeyToastPosition.center, this.expandDirection = GooeyToastExpandDirection.bottom, this.duration, this.icon, this.stateTag, this.compactChild, this.expandedChild, this.action, this.autopilot = const GooeyAutopilot(), this.persistUntilDismissed = false, this.animationStyle, this.shapeStyle, this.bodyAnimationStyle, this.width, this.roundness, this.compactMorph, this.onExpansionChanged});
  String title;
  String? description;
  GooeyToastState state;
/// Horizontal anchor; `center` renders at the top-center window edge with
/// the default expand direction.
  GooeyToastPosition position;
  GooeyToastExpandDirection expandDirection;
  Duration? duration;
  IconData? icon;
/// Identity of the compact content: change it (with the same toast id) to
/// morph the pill instead of replacing the toast.
  Object? stateTag;
/// Custom compact row replacing the default icon + title.
  Widget? compactChild;
  Widget? expandedChild;
  GooeyToastAction? action;
/// Auto expand/collapse policy; null leaves expansion to interaction.
  GooeyAutopilot? autopilot;
  bool persistUntilDismissed;
/// Open/close profile override; falls back to the theme, then `sileo`.
  GooeyToastAnimationStyle? animationStyle;
/// Corner profile override; falls back to the theme, then `defaultShape`.
  GooeyToastShapeStyle? shapeStyle;
/// Body content profile override; falls back to the theme, then `fade`.
  GooeyToastBodyAnimationStyle? bodyAnimationStyle;
/// Surface width override; falls back to the theme, then `350`.
  double? width;
/// Base roundness override; falls back to the theme, then `18`.
  double? roundness;
/// Compact morph override; falls back to the theme, then the default.
  GooeyCompactMorph? compactMorph;
/// Called with `true` when the body starts opening and `false` when closed.
  ValueChanged<bool>? onExpansionChanged;
}
/// Snapshot of one active toast, newest first in

  GooeyToastState state;
/// Horizontal anchor.
  GooeyToastPosition position;
/// Vertical growth direction.
  GooeyToastExpandDirection expandDirection;
/// Configured lifetime before dismiss.
  Duration duration;

  bool persistUntilDismissed;
/// Timestamp of the last update.
  DateTime updatedAt;
}

/// Chip label text style: upstream chip `text-xs`, medium weight.
///
/// The 16px (`1rem`) line matches Tailwind's `text-xs` line height, so the
/// chip measures 16 + `py-0.5` (4) = 20 like the badge.
const TextStyle chipDefaultTextStyle = TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500, height: 4 / 3);
/// Padding of a chip: upstream `px-2 py-0.5`, density-scaled.
const EdgeInsetsGeometry chipDefaultPadding = EdgeInsetsDensity.pxSymmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 2);
/// Padding of an inner [ChipButton]: the remove/expand control has no padding
/// of its own, it only fills the slot the chip reserves for it.

/// Theme container for the chip component.
///
/// Every field is nullable: an override leg sets only what it changes and
/// [merge] keeps the lower leg's remaining fields.
class ChipTheme extends ComponentThemeData implements Mergeable<ChipTheme> {
/// Creates a chip theme.
  const ChipTheme({super.themeDensity, super.themeSpacing, super.themeShadows, this.variant, this.padding, this.textStyle, this.style, this.buttonPadding, this.buttonIconSize});

/// [ButtonVariant.secondary].
  ButtonVariant? variant;

/// [chipDefaultPadding].
  EdgeInsetsGeometry? padding;

  TextStyle? textStyle;

  ButtonVariantStyle? style;

/// [chipButtonDefaultPadding].
  EdgeInsetsGeometry? buttonPadding;

/// [chipButtonDefaultIconSize].
  double? buttonIconSize;

  ChipTheme copyWith({ValueGetter<ButtonVariant?>? variant, ValueGetter<EdgeInsetsGeometry?>? padding, ValueGetter<TextStyle?>? textStyle, ValueGetter<ButtonVariantStyle?>? style, ValueGetter<EdgeInsetsGeometry?>? buttonPadding, ValueGetter<double?>? buttonIconSize});
/// First-non-null-wins merge; the receiver (higher-priority leg) wins.
  ChipTheme merge(ChipTheme? fallback);
/// Enums step at `t = 0.5`; padding, icon size and text styles interpolate.
  static ChipTheme lerp(ChipTheme a, ChipTheme b, double t);
  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;

/// Token-derived baseline values; unset override fields fall through here.
const ChipTheme chipDefaults = ChipTheme(variant: ButtonVariant.secondary, padding: chipDefaultPadding, textStyle: chipDefaultTextStyle, buttonPadding: chipButtonDefaultPadding, buttonIconSize: chipButtonDefaultIconSize);
/// A compact button shaped like a upstream chip (`px-2 py-0.5 text-xs`).
///
/// Without [onPressed] the chip is a static token: it paints the variant's
/// colours at full strength and never enters the focus tree. The old widget
/// passed `onPressed ?? () {}`, so a read-only chip was an enabled button that
/// swallowed taps and showed its hover/press rows.
///
/// Pass [onDeleted] for a removable token: Backspace/Delete on the focused
/// chip fires it (the preview wires it to remove the chip from its list).
class Chip extends StatelessWidget {
/// Creates a chip.
  const Chip({super.key, required this.child, this.onPressed, this.onDeleted, this.leading, this.trailing, this.variant, this.padding, this.onHover, this.onFocusChange, this.focusNode, this.autofocus = false, this.theme});
/// Chip content, usually a `Text`.
  Widget child;
/// Turns the chip into a press target when provided.
  VoidCallback? onPressed;
/// Fired when Backspace/Delete hits the focused chip; makes a press-less
/// chip focusable so removable tokens are keyboard-deletable.
  VoidCallback? onDeleted;
/// Widget shown before [child].
  Widget? leading;
/// Widget shown after [child].
  Widget? trailing;
/// Button variant override; null resolves `ChipTheme.variant`.
  ButtonVariant? variant;
/// Padding override; null resolves `ChipTheme.padding`.
  EdgeInsetsGeometry? padding;
/// Called when the hover state changes.
  ValueChanged<bool>? onHover;
/// Called when the focus state changes.
  ValueChanged<bool>? onFocusChange;
/// Focus node of a pressable chip; ignored when [onPressed] is null.
  FocusNode? focusNode;
/// Whether a pressable chip requests focus when first built.
  bool autofocus;
/// Widget-leg override, merged over the component/app/defaults legs.
  ChipTheme? theme;
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}
/// The borderless control embedded in a [Chip] (remove, expand, clear).
///
/// It renders the `ghost` button row with no padding, so it lines up with the
/// chip's content and shows no fill until it is hovered.
class ChipButton extends StatelessWidget {
/// Creates an inner chip control.
  const ChipButton({super.key, required this.child, this.onPressed, this.iconSize, this.focusNode, this.autofocus = false, this.theme});
/// Control content, usually an `Icon`.
  Widget child;
/// Called on tap; null makes the control static.
  VoidCallback? onPressed;
/// Icon size override; null resolves `ChipTheme.buttonIconSize`.
  double? iconSize;
/// Focus node; ignored when [onPressed] is null.
  FocusNode? focusNode;
/// Whether the control requests focus when first built.
  bool autofocus;
/// Widget-leg override, merged over the component/app/defaults legs.
  ChipTheme? theme;
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}
/// Named docs examples for `avatar`; the first entry is the default.
const List<ComponentPreview> avatarPreviews = <ComponentPreview>[ComponentPreview('Image', _avatarImage), ComponentPreview('Initials', _avatarInitials), ComponentPreview('Badge', _avatarBadge), ComponentPreview('Group', _avatarGroup)];
/// Overrides applied app-wide through `ComponentThemes`.
const AvatarTheme avatarThemeOverrides = AvatarTheme();
/// One avatar's visual contract.
///
/// Every field is nullable: an override leg sets only what it changes and
/// [merge] keeps the lower leg's remaining fields. `size`, `borderRadius` and
/// `badgeSize` resolve at build because their real defaults follow the
/// ambient scaling factor (`32 * scaling`, a full circle, `10 * scaling`).
class AvatarTheme extends ComponentThemeData implements Mergeable<AvatarTheme> {
/// Creates an avatar theme.
  const AvatarTheme({super.themeDensity, super.themeSpacing, super.themeShadows, this.size, this.borderRadius, this.backgroundColor, this.foregroundColor, this.textStyle, this.badgeSize, this.badgeBorderRadius, this.badgeColor, this.badgeForeground, this.badgeAlignment, this.badgeGap});
/// Diameter in logical pixels; null resolves `32 * scaling`.
  double? size;
/// Corner radius of the tile; null resolves a full circle.
  BorderRadiusGeometry? borderRadius;
/// Fill behind the initials (and behind a transparent image).
  ThemedColor? backgroundColor;
/// Initials colour.
  ThemedColor? foregroundColor;
/// Initials text style; its colour is overridden by [foregroundColor].
  TextStyle? textStyle;
/// Badge diameter; null resolves `10 * scaling`.
  double? badgeSize;
/// Badge corner radius; null resolves a full circle.
  BorderRadiusGeometry? badgeBorderRadius;
/// Badge fill; null resolves the `primary` token.
  ThemedColor? badgeColor;
/// Colour applied to the badge's child (text/icon).
  ThemedColor? badgeForeground;
/// Where the badge sits inside the tile.
  AlignmentGeometry? badgeAlignment;
/// Inset of the badge from the tile edge.
  double? badgeGap;
/// Returns a copy with the given fields replaced.
  AvatarTheme copyWith({ValueGetter<double?>? size, ValueGetter<BorderRadiusGeometry?>? borderRadius, ValueGetter<ThemedColor?>? backgroundColor, ValueGetter<ThemedColor?>? foregroundColor, ValueGetter<TextStyle?>? textStyle, ValueGetter<double?>? badgeSize, ValueGetter<BorderRadiusGeometry?>? badgeBorderRadius, ValueGetter<ThemedColor?>? badgeColor, ValueGetter<ThemedColor?>? badgeForeground, ValueGetter<AlignmentGeometry?>? badgeAlignment, ValueGetter<double?>? badgeGap});
/// First-non-null-wins merge; the receiver (higher-priority leg) wins.
  AvatarTheme merge(AvatarTheme? fallback);
/// Colours and styles step at t < 0.5; dimensions are lerped.
  static AvatarTheme lerp(AvatarTheme a, AvatarTheme b, double t);
  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;
}
/// Token-derived baseline; every unset override field falls through here.
///
/// `size`, `borderRadius`, `badgeSize` and `badgeBorderRadius` stay null on
/// purpose: their defaults depend on the ambient scaling factor and resolve
/// at build (same pattern as `dialogDefaults`).
const AvatarTheme avatarDefaults = AvatarTheme(backgroundColor: ThemedColor.ref(ColorRef.muted), foregroundColor: ThemedColor.ref(ColorRef.foreground), textStyle: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600), badgeColor: ThemedColor.ref(ColorRef.primary), badgeForeground: ThemedColor.ref(ColorRef.primaryForeground), badgeAlignment: AlignmentDirectional.bottomEnd);
/// An image or initials tile for a person or entity.
///
/// ```dart
/// const Avatar(initials: 'IB');
/// Avatar(initials: 'IB', image: NetworkImage(url), badge: AvatarBadge());
/// ```
class Avatar extends StatelessWidget {
/// Creates an avatar.
///
/// [initials] is the fallback shown while [image] is absent or cannot be
/// decoded. [badge] is usually an [AvatarBadge].
  const Avatar({super.key, required this.initials, this.image, this.size, this.borderRadius, this.backgroundColor, this.foregroundColor, this.textStyle, this.fit = BoxFit.cover, this.badge, this.badgeAlignment, this.badgeGap, this.theme});
/// Fallback label; also the accessible label of the tile.
  String initials;
/// Optional photo. When it fails to decode, [initials] are shown.
  ImageProvider? image;
/// Diameter override; null uses [AvatarTheme.size] then `32 * scaling`
/// (upstream `size-8`).
  double? size;
/// Corner radius override; null uses [AvatarTheme.borderRadius] then a
/// full circle.
  BorderRadiusGeometry? borderRadius;
/// Initials fill override.
  Color? backgroundColor;
/// Initials colour override.
  Color? foregroundColor;
/// Initials style override.
  TextStyle? textStyle;
/// How the image fills the tile.
  BoxFit fit;
/// Optional badge overlaid on the tile.
  Widget? badge;
/// Where [badge] sits; null uses [AvatarTheme.badgeAlignment] then the
/// bottom end corner.
  AlignmentGeometry? badgeAlignment;
/// Inset of [badge] from the tile edge.
  double? badgeGap;
/// Widget-leg theme override, merged on top of the other legs.
  AvatarTheme? theme;
/// Two-letter fallback for [name] (`'Ibrar Ahmed'` -> `'IA'`).
///
/// Returns the first two characters for a single word, or the first
/// character of the first two words, uppercased. Empty input returns `''`.
  static String getInitials(String name);
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}
/// A small circular badge drawn on an [Avatar] corner.
///
/// ```dart
/// const Avatar(
///   initials: 'IB',
///   badge: AvatarBadge(child: Icon(LucideIcons.check)),
/// );
/// ```
class AvatarBadge extends StatelessWidget {
/// Creates a badge.
  const AvatarBadge({super.key, this.child, this.size, this.borderRadius, this.color, this.foregroundColor, this.theme});
/// Badge content, usually an icon or a short text.
  Widget? child;
/// Diameter override; null uses [AvatarTheme.badgeSize] then
/// `10 * scaling` (upstream `size-2.5` on the default avatar).
  double? size;
/// Corner radius override; null is a full circle.
  BorderRadiusGeometry? borderRadius;
/// Fill override; null uses [AvatarTheme.badgeColor] then the `primary`
/// token.
  Color? color;
/// Child colour override (text and icons).
  Color? foregroundColor;
/// Widget-leg theme override, merged on top of the other legs.
  AvatarTheme? theme;
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}
/// Overlaps several [Avatar]s with a background-coloured ring between them.
///
/// ```dart
/// const AvatarGroup(
///   children: <Widget>[Avatar(initials: 'IB'), Avatar(initials: 'AC')],
/// );
/// ```
class AvatarGroup extends StatelessWidget {
/// Creates an avatar group.
  const AvatarGroup({super.key, required this.children, this.size, this.overlap, this.ringWidth = 2, this.clipBehavior = Clip.none, this.borderRadius});
/// Tiles to overlap, first in front; usually [Avatar]s.
  List<Widget> children;
/// Tile diameter; null resolves `32 * scaling` (upstream `size-8`).
/// Children are laid out at this size; an inner [Avatar.size] has no
/// effect.
  double? size;
/// How far each tile overlaps its predecessor; null resolves
/// `size * 0.3`.
  double? overlap;
/// Width of the background ring around each tile.
  double ringWidth;
/// Clip behavior of the group's stack.
  Clip clipBehavior;
/// Shape of the background ring; null is a full circle, matching the
/// default circular tile. Pass the tile radius when grouping
/// rounded-square tiles so the ring does not peek out.
  BorderRadiusGeometry? borderRadius;
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}

/// Overrides applied app-wide through `ComponentThemes`.
const MediaQueryVisibilityTheme mediaQueryVisibilityThemeOverrides = MediaQueryVisibilityTheme();
/// Width-driven child switching.
///
/// ```dart
/// MediaQueryVisibility(
///   minWidth: 768,
///   alternateChild: const MobileNav(),
///   child: const DesktopNav(),
/// )
/// ```
///
/// Both bounds are optional: with neither the child always shows. An
/// out-of-range viewport renders [alternateChild] when it is given, and a
/// zero-size box otherwise, so the widget never reserves layout space for
/// content it is not showing.
class MediaQueryVisibility extends StatelessWidget {
/// Creates a width-responsive child switch.
  const MediaQueryVisibility({super.key, this.minWidth, this.maxWidth, required this.child, this.alternateChild, this.theme});
/// Narrowest viewport width (inclusive) that shows [child].
  double? minWidth;
/// Widest viewport width (inclusive) that shows [child].
  double? maxWidth;
/// Shown while the viewport width is inside the range.
  Widget child;
/// Shown while the viewport width is outside the range; null collapses the
/// box instead.
  Widget? alternateChild;
/// Widget-leg theme override, merged on top of the other legs.
  MediaQueryVisibilityTheme? theme;
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}
/// Viewport bounds shared by every [MediaQueryVisibility] in a subtree.
///
/// Only breakpoint numbers live here; nothing about this theme is a token, so
/// the defaults are deliberately empty and the widget arguments stay the
/// primary way to set them.
class MediaQueryVisibilityTheme extends ComponentThemeData implements Mergeable<MediaQueryVisibilityTheme> {
/// Creates a visibility theme.
  const MediaQueryVisibilityTheme({super.themeDensity, super.themeSpacing, super.themeShadows, this.minWidth, this.maxWidth});
/// Narrowest viewport width (inclusive) that shows the main child.
  double? minWidth;
/// Widest viewport width (inclusive) that shows the main child.
  double? maxWidth;
/// Returns a copy with the given fields replaced.
///
/// The density/spacing/shadow fields are carried over, which the old
/// `MediaQueryVisibilityTheme.copyWith` did not do.
  MediaQueryVisibilityTheme copyWith({ValueGetter<double?>? minWidth, ValueGetter<double?>? maxWidth});
/// First-non-null-wins merge; the receiver (higher-priority leg) wins.
  MediaQueryVisibilityTheme merge(MediaQueryVisibilityTheme? fallback);
/// Discrete fields step at t < 0.5.
  static MediaQueryVisibilityTheme lerp(MediaQueryVisibilityTheme a, MediaQueryVisibilityTheme b, double t);
  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;
}
/// No breakpoints by default: a `MediaQueryVisibility` with no widget
/// arguments always shows its child.
const MediaQueryVisibilityTheme mediaQueryVisibilityDefaults = MediaQueryVisibilityTheme();

/// A stack of [ChatBubble]s with optional avatars; it publishes its surface overrides as the scoped theme leg.

  ThemedColor? color;

  BorderRadiusGeometry? borderRadius;
  EdgeInsetsGeometry? padding;

  ChatTheme? theme;

/// Named docs examples for `chat`; the first entry is the default.
const List<ComponentPreview> chatPreviews = <ComponentPreview>[ComponentPreview('Default', _chatDefault), ComponentPreview('Incoming', _chatIncoming), ComponentPreview('Outgoing', _chatOutgoing), ComponentPreview('Grouped', _chatGrouped)];
/// Bubble style (the old `ChatBubbleType` class hierarchy, data per the
/// component rules).
enum ChatBubbleVariant { plain, tail, sharpCorner }
/// Which bubble of a [ChatGroup] carries the tail.
enum ChatTailBehavior { first, middle, last, never }
/// Concrete corner of a bubble, after RTL resolution.
enum ChatBubbleCorner { topLeft, topRight, bottomLeft, bottomRight }
/// Directional corner, resolved with the ambient text direction.
enum ChatBubbleCornerDirectional { topStart, topEnd, bottomStart, bottomEnd }
/// The four theme legs of every chat widget: bubble surface, tail metrics,
/// group layout and reaction chips. Every field is nullable — an override
/// leg sets only what it changes and [merge] keeps the rest.
class ChatTheme extends ComponentThemeData implements Mergeable<ChatTheme> {
  const ChatTheme({super.themeDensity, super.themeSpacing, super.themeShadows, this.background, this.foreground, this.variant, this.alignment, this.widthFactor, this.padding, this.borderRadius, this.borderColor, this.borderWidth, this.tailSize, this.tailRadius, this.tailBehavior, this.spacing, this.avatarSpacing, this.avatarAlignment, this.reactionBackground, this.reactionForeground, this.reactionSelectedBackground, this.reactionSelectedForeground, this.reactionPadding});
/// Bubble fill; null resolves `primary`.
  ThemedColor? background;
/// Label/icon colour; null resolves `primaryForeground` (the old copy
/// picked it by luminance instead).
  ThemedColor? foreground;
  ChatBubbleVariant? variant;
/// Side of the row; null = `AlignmentDirectional.centerEnd`.
  AlignmentGeometry? alignment;
  double? widthFactor;
/// Inner padding; null = the upstream bubble's `px-3 py-2` (12/8) as an
/// [EdgeInsetsDensity].
  EdgeInsetsGeometry? padding;
/// Corner radius; null resolves the ambient `radiusLg`.
  BorderRadiusGeometry? borderRadius;
/// Outline colour/width; null draws no border.
  ThemedColor? borderColor;
  double? borderWidth;
/// Tail extent / tip rounding; null = `8 x 8` / ambient `radiusSm`.
  Size? tailSize;
  double? tailRadius;
/// Which bubble of a group carries the tail; null = [ChatTailBehavior.last].
  ChatTailBehavior? tailBehavior;
/// Gap between a group's bubbles; null resolves `2` (a `Row`/`Column`
/// spacing, so it cannot carry a density multiplier).
  double? spacing;
/// Avatar gap / edge alignment; null = `8` / the group default. A raw
/// `double` (`Row.spacing`), so `8` stays a literal.
  double? avatarSpacing;
  AlignmentGeometry? avatarAlignment;
/// Reaction chips: fill, label, selected fill, selected label and padding
/// (`muted` / `foreground` / `primary` / `primaryForeground` / `6 x 4`).
///
/// The padding is a pill `px-1.5 py-1` [EdgeInsetsDensity].
  ThemedColor? reactionBackground;
  ThemedColor? reactionForeground;
  ThemedColor? reactionSelectedBackground;
  ThemedColor? reactionSelectedForeground;
  EdgeInsetsGeometry? reactionPadding;
  ChatTheme copyWith({ValueGetter<ThemedColor?>? background, ValueGetter<ThemedColor?>? foreground, ValueGetter<ChatBubbleVariant?>? variant, ValueGetter<AlignmentGeometry?>? alignment, ValueGetter<double?>? widthFactor, ValueGetter<EdgeInsetsGeometry?>? padding, ValueGetter<BorderRadiusGeometry?>? borderRadius, ValueGetter<ThemedColor?>? borderColor, ValueGetter<double?>? borderWidth, ValueGetter<Size?>? tailSize, ValueGetter<double?>? tailRadius, ValueGetter<ChatTailBehavior?>? tailBehavior, ValueGetter<double?>? spacing, ValueGetter<double?>? avatarSpacing, ValueGetter<AlignmentGeometry?>? avatarAlignment, ValueGetter<ThemedColor?>? reactionBackground, ValueGetter<ThemedColor?>? reactionForeground, ValueGetter<ThemedColor?>? reactionSelectedBackground, ValueGetter<ThemedColor?>? reactionSelectedForeground, ValueGetter<EdgeInsetsGeometry?>? reactionPadding});
  ChatTheme merge(ChatTheme? fallback);
  static ChatTheme lerp(ChatTheme a, ChatTheme b, double t);
  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;
}
/// Token-derived baseline; unset override fields fall through here.

/// `padding` (bubble `px-3 py-2`, 12/8) and `reactionPadding` (pill

/// paint them; `spacing`/`avatarSpacing` stay plain doubles (`Row` spacing).
const ChatTheme chatDefaults = ChatTheme(background: ThemedColor.ref(ColorRef.primary), foreground: ThemedColor.ref(ColorRef.primaryForeground), variant: ChatBubbleVariant.tail, alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerEnd, widthFactor: 0.5, padding: EdgeInsetsDensity.pxSymmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8), tailSize: Size(8, 8), tailBehavior: ChatTailBehavior.last, spacing: 2, avatarSpacing: 8, avatarAlignment: AlignmentDirectional.topEnd, reactionBackground: ThemedColor.ref(ColorRef.muted), reactionForeground: ThemedColor.ref(ColorRef.foreground), reactionSelectedBackground: ThemedColor.ref(ColorRef.primary), reactionSelectedForeground: ThemedColor.ref(ColorRef.primaryForeground), reactionPadding: EdgeInsetsDensity.pxSymmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 4));

/// Which channel(s) the slider drives.
///
/// `hue`, `sat`, `val`, `alpha` are single-channel bars; the rest are 2D pads.
enum HSVColorSliderType { hue, hueSat, hueVal, hueAlpha, sat, satVal, satAlpha, val, valAlpha, alpha }
/// Interactive slider for one or two HSV channels.

  HSVColorSliderType sliderType;

/// Called when the interaction completes.
  ValueChanged<HSVColor>? onChanged;

  bool reverse;

  EdgeInsets padding;

  bool enabled;

  HSVSliderStyle? style;

  FocusNode? focusNode;

  bool autofocus;
  State<HSVColorSlider> createState();
}

/// Whether re-selecting the current choice clears it, per widget kind.
///
/// A single [MultipleChoice] keeps a selection once made (upstream radio
/// behaviour), while a [MultipleAnswer] toggles items off.

  bool? allowUnselect;

  MultipleChoiceTheme merge(MultipleChoiceTheme? fallback);

  static MultipleChoiceTheme lerp(MultipleChoiceTheme a, MultipleChoiceTheme b, double t);

  int get hashCode;
}

/// The selection protocol every choice item reads from its scope.
///
/// Items call [Choice.choose] / [Choice.getValue] with the nearest scope; any
/// widget can be a choice item as long as it does that.
mixin Choice<T> {
/// Selects (or toggles) [item] in the nearest scope.
  static void choose<T>(BuildContext context, T item);
/// The selected items of the nearest scope, or null when there is none.
  static Iterable<T>? getValue<T>(BuildContext context);
/// Applies one user selection to this scope.
  void selectItem(T item);
/// The current selection: one item for [MultipleChoice], all items for
/// [MultipleAnswer].
  Iterable<T>? get value;
}
/// Holds the value of an uncontrolled [MultipleChoice].
class MultipleChoiceController<T> extends ValueNotifier<T?> with ComponentController<T?> {
/// Creates a controller holding a single selected item.
  MultipleChoiceController([super.value]);
}
/// Holds the values of an uncontrolled [MultipleAnswer].
class MultipleAnswerController<T> extends ValueNotifier<Iterable<T>?> with ComponentController<Iterable<T>?> {
/// Creates a controller holding the selected items.
  MultipleAnswerController([super.value]);
}
/// A single-selection scope.
///
/// Two modes:
/// * uncontrolled — pass a [controller]; `value`/`onChanged` must be null;
/// * controlled — pass `value` and `onChanged` (null `onChanged` disables).
///
/// Child items select through `Choice.choose(context, item)`.
class MultipleChoice<T> extends StatefulWidget {
/// Creates a single-selection scope.
  const MultipleChoice({super.key, required this.child, this.value, this.controller, this.onChanged, this.enabled, this.allowUnselect, this.theme});
/// The widget tree containing the choice items.
  Widget child;
/// Current selection in controlled mode.
  T? value;
/// Controller mode: the controller owns the selection.
  MultipleChoiceController<T>? controller;
/// Called with the next selection in controlled mode.
  ValueChanged<T?>? onChanged;
/// Overrides the enabled state; null means "interactive when controlled or
/// controller-driven".
  bool? enabled;
/// Whether picking the current item again clears the selection; null falls
/// back to the resolved theme (default `false`).
  bool? allowUnselect;
/// Widget-leg theme override, merged over the component/app/defaults.
  MultipleChoiceTheme? theme;
/// Creates the state object for this widget.
  State<MultipleChoice<T>> createState();
}
/// A multi-selection scope.
///
/// Two modes:
/// * uncontrolled — pass a [controller]; `value`/`onChanged` must be null;
/// * controlled — pass `value` and `onChanged` (null `onChanged` disables).
///
/// Child items select through `Choice.choose(context, item)`.
class MultipleAnswer<T> extends StatefulWidget {
/// Creates a multi-selection scope.
  const MultipleAnswer({super.key, required this.child, this.value, this.controller, this.onChanged, this.enabled, this.allowUnselect, this.theme});
/// The widget tree containing the choice items.
  Widget child;
/// Current selection in controlled mode.
  Iterable<T>? value;
/// Controller mode: the controller owns the selection.
  MultipleAnswerController<T>? controller;
/// Called with the next selection in controlled mode.
  ValueChanged<Iterable<T>?>? onChanged;
/// Overrides the enabled state; null means "interactive when controlled or
/// controller-driven".
  bool? enabled;
/// Whether picking a selected item again removes it; null falls back to the
/// resolved theme (default `true`).
  bool? allowUnselect;
/// Widget-leg theme override, merged over the component/app/defaults.
  MultipleChoiceTheme? theme;
/// Creates the state object for this widget.
  State<MultipleAnswer<T>> createState();
}

/// Holds the value of an uncontrolled [RadioSet].
class RadioSetController<T> extends ValueNotifier<T?> {
/// Creates a controller, with no selection by default.
  RadioSetController([super.value]);
/// Selects [next].
  void select(T? next);
}
/// A single-select group of radio items.
///
/// Two modes: controlled (`value` + `onChanged`, null `onChanged` disables) or
/// uncontrolled ([RadioSetController]). The group owns the layout —
/// [items] stacks along [direction] with [RadioGroupTheme.itemsGap] between
/// them (upstream `grid gap-3`) — plus the selection, the arrow-key traversal and
/// the form value.
class RadioSet<T> extends StatefulWidget {
/// Creates a radio group.
  const RadioSet({super.key, required this.items, this.value, this.controller, this.onChanged, this.enabled, this.direction = Axis.vertical, this.theme});
/// The items, stacked by the group along [direction].
  List<Widget> items;
/// The selected value in controlled mode.
  T? value;
/// Controller mode: the controller owns the selection.
  RadioSetController<T>? controller;
/// Called with the newly selected value in controlled mode.
  ValueChanged<T>? onChanged;
/// Overrides the enabled state; null means "interactive when driven".
  bool? enabled;
/// Arrow-key reading order: vertical walks top to bottom, horizontal left to
/// right.
  Axis direction;
/// Widget-leg theme override for the group.
  RadioGroupTheme? theme;
  State<RadioSet<T>> createState();
}
/// A card-shaped option of a [RadioSet]: the indicator and a whole
/// block of content.
///
/// The border *colour* reacts to selection; its width never changes, so
/// selecting a card cannot shift its content.
class RadioCard<T> extends StatefulWidget {
/// Creates a radio card.
  const RadioCard({super.key, required this.value, required this.child, this.trailing, this.enabled = true, this.focusNode, this.autofocus = false, this.theme, this.cardTheme});
/// The value this card stands for.
  T value;
/// The card content, shown next to the indicator.
  Widget child;
/// Widget shown after the content.
  Widget? trailing;
/// Whether this card accepts input.
  bool enabled;
/// Focus node; created internally when [autofocus] is true and this is null.
  FocusNode? focusNode;
/// Whether the card takes focus when first built.
  bool autofocus;
/// Widget-leg override for the indicator slice.
  SelectableRadioTheme? theme;
/// Widget-leg override for the card surface.
  SelectableCardTheme? cardTheme;
  State<RadioCard<T>> createState();
}
/// Lookup key of a radio card surface.
const ValueKey<String> kRadioCardKey = ValueKey<String>('dashcn.radio_group.card');
/// Group-level settings for a single-select group.
///
/// Every field is nullable: an override leg sets only what it changes and
/// [merge] keeps the lower leg's remaining fields.
class RadioGroupTheme extends ComponentThemeData implements Mergeable<RadioGroupTheme> {
/// Creates a radio group theme.
  const RadioGroupTheme({super.themeDensity, super.themeSpacing, super.themeShadows, this.direction, this.items, this.itemsGap, this.card});
/// Arrow-key reading order; null falls back to the widget's [Axis.vertical].
  Axis? direction;
/// Row styling for this group's items.
  SelectableRadioTheme? items;
/// Space between two items; null resolves 12 (upstream `gap-3`).
///
/// A upstream pixel value at the default density: the widget scales it with
/// the ambient density and scaling, like every other spacing it derives.
  double? itemsGap;
/// Surface styling for this group's card items.
  SelectableCardTheme? card;
/// First-non-null-wins merge; the receiver (higher-priority leg) wins.
  RadioGroupTheme merge(RadioGroupTheme? fallback);
  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;
}
/// Token-derived baseline values; unset override fields fall through here.
const RadioGroupTheme radioGroupDefaults = RadioGroupTheme(direction: Axis.vertical, items: selectableRadioDefaults, card: selectableCardDefaults);

const double radioGroupItemsGap = 12;
/// Card-surface styling for a [RadioCard].
///
/// It lives here, not in `primitives/selectable_radio/`, because a card is a
/// component-layer surface: the primitive may not import `Card`, so the shape
/// that draws one belongs to the component.
///
/// Every field is nullable: an override leg sets only what it changes and
/// [merge] keeps the lower leg's remaining fields.
class SelectableCardTheme extends ComponentThemeData implements Mergeable<SelectableCardTheme> {
/// Creates a card theme.
  const SelectableCardTheme({super.themeDensity, super.themeSpacing, super.themeShadows, this.background, this.borderColor, this.borderWidth, this.borderRadius, this.padding, this.gap});
/// Per-state fill.
  StateValue<ThemedColor>? background;
/// Per-state border colour.
  StateValue<ThemedColor>? borderColor;
/// Border width; null resolves 1. Constant per state, so selecting a card
/// can never shift its content.
  double? borderWidth;
/// Corner radius; null resolves the ambient `radiusLg` at build.
  BorderRadiusGeometry? borderRadius;
/// Inner padding; null resolves 16, density-scaled.
  EdgeInsetsGeometry? padding;
/// Space between the indicator and the content; null resolves `spacing.md`.
  double? gap;
/// First-non-null-wins merge; the receiver (higher-priority leg) wins.
  SelectableCardTheme merge(SelectableCardTheme? fallback);
  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;
}

  TextEditingController? controller;
  String? initialValue;
  FocusNode? focusNode;
  UndoHistoryController? undoController;
  WidgetStatesController? statesController;

/// One input's visual contract.
///
/// Every field is nullable: an override leg sets only what it changes and
/// [merge] keeps the lower leg's remaining fields. There are no variants and
/// no size enum; [height] is the field's minimum height.
class InputTheme extends ComponentThemeData implements Mergeable<InputTheme> {
/// Creates an input theme.
  const InputTheme({super.themeDensity, super.themeSpacing, super.themeShadows, this.background, this.borderColor, this.borderWidth, this.borderRadius, this.padding, this.textStyle, this.hintStyle, this.cursorColor, this.height});
/// Per-state fill of the input surface.
  StateValue<ThemedColor>? background;
/// Per-state border color; null draws no border. The focus ring is a
/// separate `FocusOutline`, not a border row.
  StateValue<ThemedColor>? borderColor;
/// Border width used when [borderColor] resolves non-null.
  double? borderWidth;
/// Corner radius; null resolves `theme.borderRadiusMd` at build.
  BorderRadiusGeometry? borderRadius;
/// Inner padding; null resolves the 12x8 default.
  EdgeInsetsGeometry? padding;
/// Text style override; its color wins over the foreground token.
  TextStyle? textStyle;
/// Hint/placeholder style override.
  TextStyle? hintStyle;
/// Cursor color; null resolves the `primary` token.
  ThemedColor? cursorColor;
/// Minimum field height; null resolves 36.
  double? height;
/// Returns a copy with the given fields replaced.
  InputTheme copyWith({ValueGetter<StateValue<ThemedColor>?>? background, ValueGetter<StateValue<ThemedColor>?>? borderColor, ValueGetter<double?>? borderWidth, ValueGetter<BorderRadiusGeometry?>? borderRadius, ValueGetter<EdgeInsetsGeometry?>? padding, ValueGetter<TextStyle?>? textStyle, ValueGetter<TextStyle?>? hintStyle, ValueGetter<ThemedColor?>? cursorColor, ValueGetter<double?>? height});
/// First-non-null-wins merge; the receiver (higher-priority leg) wins.
  InputTheme merge(InputTheme? fallback);
/// State scales and colors step at t < 0.5; scalars are lerped.
  static InputTheme lerp(InputTheme a, InputTheme b, double t);
  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;
}

/// Shows [builder]'s content on a [MenuPopup] surface anchored to [context].

/// A checkerboard painter used to visualize transparency.
///
/// The pattern is shown behind semi-transparent colors in color pickers or
/// image editors to make the alpha level readable on any background. Wrap in
/// a `CustomPaint` sized to the area being visualized.
class AlphaPainter extends CustomPainter {
/// Creates a checkerboard painter.
  const AlphaPainter({this.primary = checkboardPrimary, this.secondary = checkboardSecondary, this.squareSize = checkboardSize});
/// Primary color used in the checkerboard pattern.
  static const Color checkboardPrimary = Color(0xFFE0E0E0);
/// Secondary color used in the checkerboard pattern.
  static const Color checkboardSecondary = Color(0xFFB0B0B0);
/// Size of each square in the checkerboard pattern.
  static const double checkboardSize = 8.0;
/// Fill color of the even squares.
  Color primary;
/// Fill color of the odd squares.
  Color secondary;
/// Edge length of one square.
  double squareSize;
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size);
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant AlphaPainter oldDelegate);
}

/// The number of spell check suggestions the toolbar offers at once.
///
/// Kept at three to match the platform convention on iOS and Android; longer
/// lists turn the toolbar into a menu the user has to read rather than a
/// quick correction they can hit.
const int kMaxSpellCheckSuggestions = 3;
/// A upstream styled toolbar offering replacement suggestions for the
/// misspelled word under the cursor.
///
/// Build it from an [EditableTextState] with the `.editableText` constructor
/// and return it from an editable text toolbar builder; the framework places
/// it at [anchors]. The registry `input` component does not enable spell
/// check itself, so this toolbar is wired by apps that opt into
/// `EditableText`'s `spellCheckConfiguration`.
class SpellCheckSuggestionsToolbar extends StatelessWidget {
/// Creates a toolbar from explicit button items.
///
/// [buttonItems] must not contain more than three items, mirroring the
/// platform convention.
  const SpellCheckSuggestionsToolbar({super.key, required this.anchors, required this.buttonItems});
/// Creates a toolbar for [editableTextState].
///
/// Reads the misspelled span under the cursor from [editableTextState] and
/// turns its suggestions into replacement rows. When there is no misspelled
/// span, or the service offers no suggestion for it, the toolbar builds to
/// nothing.
  SpellCheckSuggestionsToolbar.editableText({super.key, required EditableTextState editableTextState});
/// Where the toolbar is anchored relative to the text field.
  TextSelectionToolbarAnchors anchors;
/// The replacement suggestions to display, at most three.
  List<ContextMenuButtonItem> buttonItems;
/// Replacement rows for the misspelled word under the cursor.
///
/// Returns an empty list when the cursor is not inside a misspelled span.
/// A misspelled span without suggestions returns one disabled placeholder
/// row; the toolbar labels it with
/// `ComponentLocalizations.spellCheckNoSuggestions`.
  static List<ContextMenuButtonItem> buildButtonItems(EditableTextState editableTextState);
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}

/// Fades the leading and trailing edges of [child] while it is scrolled.
///
/// ```dart
/// FadedScrollableViewport(
///   child: SingleChildScrollView(child: content),
/// );
/// ```
class FadedScrollableViewport extends StatefulWidget {
/// Creates a fade viewport.
  const FadedScrollableViewport({super.key, required this.child, this.fadeExtent, this.fadeSize, this.theme});
/// The scrollable subtree the fade is drawn over.
  Widget child;
/// Scroll distance over which the fade reaches full strength.
  double? fadeExtent;
/// Length of the fade gradient.
  double? fadeSize;
/// Widget-leg style override, merged on top of the other resolver legs.
  ScrollableTheme? theme;
/// Resolves the effective fade geometry for [context].
///
/// Exposed so custom masks can reuse the same four-leg resolution:
/// `widget argument > ComponentTheme in tree > app overrides > defaults`.
  static ({double fadeExtent, double fadeSize}) resolveGeometry(BuildContext context, {double? fadeExtent, double? fadeSize, ScrollableTheme? theme});
/// Colour the edge fade blends into: the ambient `background` token, so the
/// fade follows the selected preset in light and dark.
///
/// Exposed so custom masks can paint the same surface the built-in one does.
  static Color resolveFadeSurface(BuildContext context);
/// Gradient stops for the fade mask over an axis of [axisExtent].
///
/// Stops are clamped monotonic so short content cannot produce a crossed
/// gradient. Exposed for custom masks.
  static List<double> gradientStops({required double leading, required double trailing, required double fadeSize, required double axisExtent});
/// Gradient begin/end alignments for a fade viewport on [axis].
///
/// The old viewport always faded top-to-bottom, so a horizontal scrollable
/// faded the wrong edges. Exposed for custom masks.
  static ({Alignment begin, Alignment end}) gradientAxis(Axis axis);
  State<FadedScrollableViewport> createState();
}

  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;
}

/// Visual state of a dropzone surface.
///
/// The widget owns none of these transitions: the caller drives them from the
/// drag stream and the upload result.
enum DropzoneState { idle, dragging, uploading, success, error, disabled }
/// Styling of the dropzone surface.
///
/// Every field is nullable: an override leg sets only what it changes and
/// [merge] keeps the lower leg's remaining fields.
class DropzoneTheme extends ComponentThemeData implements Mergeable<DropzoneTheme> {
/// Creates a dropzone theme.
  const DropzoneTheme({super.themeDensity, super.themeSpacing, super.themeShadows, this.background, this.borderColor, this.dragBorder, this.borderWidth, this.borderRadius, this.padding, this.minHeight, this.iconColor, this.iconSize, this.statusStyle, this.hintStyle, this.gap, this.hintGap, this.actionGap, this.focusRingColor, this.focusRingSpread, this.hoverScale, this.duration});
/// Surface fill; null draws no fill (the ambient background shows through).
  ThemedColor? background;
/// Per-state border colour; a state's own colour wins over this.
  StateValue<ThemedColor>? borderColor;
/// Border colour while a drag hovers over the surface; null falls back to
/// the `hovered` row of [borderColor], then to [DropzoneState.dragging]'s
/// token.
  ThemedColor? dragBorder;
/// Border width; null resolves 1.
  double? borderWidth;
/// Corner radius; null resolves the ambient `radiusLg`.
  BorderRadiusGeometry? borderRadius;
/// Inner padding; null resolves `p-6` (24), density-scaled.
  EdgeInsetsGeometry? padding;
/// Minimum height; null resolves 0 (the surface hugs its content).
  double? minHeight;
/// Icon colour; null resolves `mutedForeground`.
  ThemedColor? iconColor;
/// Icon side; null resolves 28.
  double? iconSize;
/// Status line style; its colour falls back to `mutedForeground`.
  TextStyle? statusStyle;
/// Hint line style; its colour falls back to `mutedForeground`.
  TextStyle? hintStyle;
/// Space between the icon, the status line and the action; null resolves 16.
  double? gap;
/// Space between the status line and the hint; null resolves 4.
  double? hintGap;
/// Space between the hint and the action; null resolves 24.
  double? actionGap;
/// Focus ring colour; null resolves `ring`.
  ThemedColor? focusRingColor;
/// Focus ring spread; null resolves 2.
  double? focusRingSpread;
/// Icon scale while a drag hovers; null resolves 1.05.
  double? hoverScale;
/// Animation duration; null resolves 150ms.
  Duration? duration;
/// First-non-null-wins merge; the receiver (higher-priority leg) wins.
  DropzoneTheme merge(DropzoneTheme? fallback);
  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;
}

  bool showAction;

  DropzoneTheme? theme;
/// Focus node for keyboard activation; null creates one internally.
  FocusNode? focusNode;
/// Whether the surface requests focus when first built.
  bool autofocus;
  Widget build(BuildContext context);

/// A gradient area that varies an HSV/HSL colour along configurable axes.

///   ),
/// )

  Color color;

  ColorFieldMode mode;
/// Hue ramp axis (both modes).
  ColorFieldAxis hueAxis;

  ColorFieldAxis saturationAxis;
/// Value ramp axis ([ColorFieldMode.hsv] only).

  ColorFieldAxis alphaAxis;

  ColorFieldTheme? theme;
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}

/// A command palette with a search field, async results and keyboard support.
class Command extends StatefulWidget {

  CommandBuilder builder;

  Duration debounceDuration;

  Widget? searchPlaceholder;

  CommandTheme? theme;

}

  CommandTheme merge(CommandTheme? fallback);

/// How long a [AppPageRoute] takes to push or pop.
const Duration kPageTransitionDuration = Duration(milliseconds: 300);
/// The upstream page transition: a fade combined with a short vertical slide.
///
/// Shared by [AppPageRoute] and [AppPage] so a route and a declarative
/// page look identical. Built from one [SlideTransition], so a page adds
/// exactly one [Transform] to the tree.
///
/// The tween pairs are instance fields rather than `static final`: they are
/// `Animatable`s, which cannot be `const`, and a lazily-initialised static
/// would be global mutable state.
class AppPageTransition extends StatelessWidget {
/// Creates a upstream page transition.
  const AppPageTransition({super.key, required this.animation, required this.child});
/// Drives the incoming page.
  Animation<double> animation;
/// The page content.
  Widget child;
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}
/// A route that displays a full-screen page with the upstream transition.
///
/// The registry replacement for `MaterialPageRoute`; it depends on nothing
/// outside `package:flutter/widgets.dart`.
///
/// ```dart
/// Navigator.of(context).push(
///   AppPageRoute(builder: (context) => const SettingsPage()),
/// );
/// ```
///
/// See also:
///
/// * [AppPage], the [Page] equivalent for declarative navigation (Router,
///   `go_router`, `Navigator.pages`).
class AppPageRoute<T> extends PageRoute<T> {
/// Creates a page route that renders [builder] with the upstream transition.
  AppPageRoute({required this.builder, super.settings, this.maintainState = true, super.fullscreenDialog, this._opaque = true, this.transitionDuration = kPageTransitionDuration, this.barrierLabel});
/// Builds the primary content of the route.
  WidgetBuilder builder;
  bool maintainState;
  Duration transitionDuration;
  String? barrierLabel;
  bool get opaque;
  Color? get barrierColor;
/// Whether this route animates into [nextRoute].
///
/// The old implementation answered `nextRoute is AppPageRoute`, so pushing
/// a dialog, a drawer or any other route on top of a page skipped the page's
/// exit transition. The framework default (`true`) is used instead.
  bool canTransitionTo(TransitionRoute<dynamic> nextRoute);
  Widget buildPage(BuildContext context, Animation<double> animation, Animation<double> secondaryAnimation);
  Widget buildTransitions(BuildContext context, Animation<double> animation, Animation<double> secondaryAnimation, Widget child);
  String get debugLabel;
}
/// A [Page] that creates a [AppPageRoute].
///
/// The registry replacement for `MaterialPage`, for use with declarative
/// navigation APIs such as [Navigator.pages] or `go_router`.
///
/// ```dart
/// Navigator(
///   pages: [
///     AppPage(key: const ValueKey('home'), child: const HomePage()),
///     if (showSettings)
///       AppPage(key: const ValueKey('settings'), child: const SettingsPage()),
///   ],
///   onDidRemovePage: (page) {},
/// );
/// ```
class AppPage<T> extends Page<T> {
/// Creates a page backed by a [AppPageRoute].
  const AppPage({required this.child, this.maintainState = true, this.fullscreenDialog = false, this.transitionDuration = kPageTransitionDuration, super.key, super.canPop, super.onPopInvoked, super.name, super.arguments, super.restorationId});
/// The content to show for this page.
  Widget child;
/// Whether to keep the page's state alive while it is covered.
  bool maintainState;
/// Whether the page is presented as a modal dialog.
  bool fullscreenDialog;
/// How long the push and pop animation runs for.
  Duration transitionDuration;
  Route<T> createRoute(BuildContext context);
}

/// Theme of the code snippet container.

/// Scrollable code block with optional top-right [actions] (copy, run).
///
/// The [code] content renders in the ambient monospace small style. When a
/// [language] is given (or auto-detected from a fence tag / strong content
/// signals), the code is syntax-highlighted with the theme's `syntax` token
/// group. The block sits inside a [SelectableRegion], so the source is
/// selectable by mouse, by the keyboard (`Ctrl/Cmd+A`, then `Ctrl/Cmd+C`) and
/// through the platform context menu; [Text] and [Text.rich] register with
/// the region on their own, so the syntax colours are unchanged.
class CodeSnippet extends StatelessWidget {
/// Creates a code snippet display.
  const CodeSnippet({super.key, this.constraints, this.actions = const <Widget>[], required this.code, this.language, this.theme});
/// Bounds of the snippet area.
  BoxConstraints? constraints;
/// Action buttons in the top-right corner.
  List<Widget> actions;
/// Code content (usually a [Text]).
  Widget code;
/// Language id or fence tag (`dart`, `js`, `py`, …) used for syntax
/// highlighting. When null, the language is auto-detected from the code
/// text (fence tag first, then conservative content signals); unknown
/// content stays plain.
  String? language;
/// Widget-leg theme override, merged over the other legs.
  CodeSnippetTheme? theme;
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}

/// A one-time-password / verification-code input. The code lives in one hidden
/// field; the slots are painted from the string (see README.md).
class InputOtp extends StatefulWidget {
/// Creates an OTP input.
  const InputOtp({super.key, required this.length, this.controller, this.initialValue, this.onChanged, this.onCompleted, this.onSubmitted, this.keyboardType = TextInputType.number, this.obscureText = false, this.readOnly = false, this.enabled = true, this.autofocus = false, this.textCapitalization = TextCapitalization.none, this.autofillHints = const <String>[AutofillHints.oneTimeCode], this.inputFormatters, this.filter, this.separator, this.separatorEvery, this.validator, this.autovalidateMode = FormValidationMode.changed, this.theme});
/// Number of slots.
  int length;
/// Controller for the whole code; created internally when null.
  TextEditingController? controller;
/// Initial code; ignored when [controller] is given.
  String? initialValue;
/// Called with the whole code whenever it changes.
  ValueChanged<String>? onChanged;
/// Called once, the first time every slot is filled.
  ValueChanged<String>? onCompleted;
/// Called when the field is submitted (Enter / the platform action).
  ValueChanged<String>? onSubmitted;
/// Keyboard type; digits by default.
  TextInputType keyboardType;
/// Whether each character is replaced by a dot.
  bool obscureText;
/// Whether the code can be edited.
  bool readOnly;
/// Whether the field accepts input; a disabled field is dimmed to 50%.
  bool enabled;
  bool autofocus;
  TextCapitalization textCapitalization;
  Iterable<String>? autofillHints;
  List<TextInputFormatter>? inputFormatters;
/// Rejects a character when it returns false. Null accepts everything.
  bool Function(String character)? filter;
/// Widget drawn after every [separatorEvery] slots; needs [separatorEvery].
  Widget? separator;
/// Slots between two separators.
  int? separatorEvery;
/// Validation of the whole code; the message renders below the row, but only
/// once every slot is filled. The validator itself runs on every change
/// (per [autovalidateMode]) and sees partial codes along the way.
  String? Function(String? code)? validator;
/// When [validator] runs: `initial` on mount, `changed` on every change,
/// `submitted` on submit; all three also when [validator] itself changes.
  FormValidationMode autovalidateMode;
/// Widget-leg theme override, merged on top of the other legs.
  InputOtpTheme? theme;
  State<InputOtp> createState();
}
/// Named docs examples for `input_otp`; the first entry is the default.

/// Visual contract of the OTP slots.
class InputOtpTheme extends ComponentThemeData implements Mergeable<InputOtpTheme> {
/// Creates an input-otp theme.
  const InputOtpTheme({super.themeDensity, super.themeSpacing, super.themeShadows, this.background, this.borderColor, this.borderWidth, this.borderRadius, this.padding, this.textStyle, this.boxSize, this.spacing, this.separatorTextStyle, this.cursorColor});
/// Per-state fill of a slot; null resolves `input` at 30% alpha.
  StateValue<ThemedColor>? background;
/// Per-state slot border; null resolves the `input` token.
  StateValue<ThemedColor>? borderColor;
/// Border width used when [borderColor] resolves; null resolves 1.
  double? borderWidth;
/// Corner radius; null resolves `borderRadiusMd`.
  BorderRadiusGeometry? borderRadius;
/// Inner padding; null resolves 6 x 0 (`px-1.5 py-0`), density-scaled
/// through [inputOtpDefaultPadding].
  EdgeInsetsGeometry? padding;
/// Slot label style; its colour is ignored (taken from the foreground).
  TextStyle? textStyle;

/// Corner-radius multipliers for one button inside a [ButtonGroup].
///
/// Start/end values are mapped to left/right by the ambient text direction in
/// [apply], so groups flip correctly under RTL.
class ButtonGroupData {
/// Creates data with per-corner multipliers.
  const ButtonGroupData({required this.topStart, required this.topEnd, required this.bottomStart, required this.bottomEnd});
/// Multiplies every corner by [value].
  const ButtonGroupData.all(double value);
/// Multiplies the horizontal edges (start/end).
  const ButtonGroupData.horizontal({double start = 1, double end = 1});
/// Multiplies the vertical edges (top/bottom).
  const ButtonGroupData.vertical({double top = 1, double bottom = 1});
/// No modification: full radius on every corner.
  static const ButtonGroupData none = ButtonGroupData.all(1);
/// Removes every corner: an inner button of a group.
  static const ButtonGroupData zero = ButtonGroupData.all(0);
/// First button of a horizontal group: start radius kept, end flattened.
  static const ButtonGroupData horizontalStart = ButtonGroupData.horizontal(end: 0);
/// Last button of a horizontal group: start flattened, end radius kept.
  static const ButtonGroupData horizontalEnd = ButtonGroupData.horizontal(start: 0);
/// First button of a vertical group: top radius kept, bottom flattened.
  static const ButtonGroupData verticalTop = ButtonGroupData.vertical(bottom: 0);
/// Last button of a vertical group: top flattened, bottom radius kept.
  static const ButtonGroupData verticalBottom = ButtonGroupData.vertical(top: 0);
/// Outer top-start corner multiplier.
  double topStart;
/// Outer top-end corner multiplier.
  double topEnd;
/// Outer bottom-start corner multiplier.
  double bottomStart;
/// Outer bottom-end corner multiplier.
  double bottomEnd;
/// Data for the button at [index] of a horizontal group of [length].
  factory ButtonGroupData.horizontalIndex(int index, int length);
/// Data for the button at [index] of a vertical group of [length].
  factory ButtonGroupData.verticalIndex(int index, int length);
/// Scales [radius] by the corner multipliers for [direction].
  BorderRadius apply(BorderRadius radius, TextDirection direction);
/// Multiplies this data with an enclosing group's data (nested groups).
  ButtonGroupData combine(ButtonGroupData other);
  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;
  String toString();
}

class ButtonGroup extends StatelessWidget {

  const ButtonGroup.horizontal({super.key, this.expands = false, required this.children});
/// Creates a vertical (column) button group.
  const ButtonGroup.vertical({super.key, this.expands = false, required this.children});
/// Layout direction of the group.
  Axis direction;
/// Whether the group takes the full main-axis extent of its parent.
  bool expands;
/// Buttons in visual order. First and last are rounded; the rest are not.
  List<Widget> children;
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}

/// A pressable action control.
///
/// Use a [ButtonGroup] to connect several buttons; on/off state belongs to the
/// separate `Toggle` component. Rare gestures (secondary click, tap-down
/// tracking) are available through an outer `GestureDetector`.
class Button extends StatefulWidget {
/// Creates a button.
  const Button({super.key, required this.child, this.variant = ButtonVariant.primary, this.size = ButtonSize.md, this.onPressed, this.onLongPress, this.onHover, this.onFocusChange, this.leading, this.trailing, this.focusNode, this.autofocus = false, this.enabled, this.theme});
/// Button content, usually a `Text` or an `Icon`.
  Widget child;
/// Visual variant. Defaults to [ButtonVariant.primary].
  ButtonVariant variant;
/// Fixed size row. Defaults to [ButtonSize.md].
  ButtonSize size;
/// Called on tap. When null the button is disabled unless [enabled] is true.
  VoidCallback? onPressed;
/// Called on long press. Ignored while the button is disabled.
  VoidCallback? onLongPress;
/// Called when the hover state changes.
  ValueChanged<bool>? onHover;
/// Called when the focus state changes.
  ValueChanged<bool>? onFocusChange;
/// Widget shown before [child].
  Widget? leading;
/// Widget shown after [child].
  Widget? trailing;
/// Focus node. A node is created internally when [autofocus] is true and
/// this is null; otherwise the internal `Clickable` owns its own node.
  FocusNode? focusNode;
/// Whether the button requests focus when first built.
  bool autofocus;
/// Overrides the enabled state; null means `onPressed != null`.
  bool? enabled;
/// Widget-leg style override, merged on top of the component/app/defaults.
  ButtonVariantStyle? theme;
  State<Button> createState();
}
/// Visual variants of the button component.
enum ButtonVariant { primary, secondary, outline, ghost, link, text, destructive }
/// Fixed button sizes. Global density scales the size table's padding.
enum ButtonSize { xs, sm, md, lg, icon }
/// Fallback text style before the size table narrows the font size.
const TextStyle buttonDefaultTextStyle = TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500);

  double? borderWidth;

  StateValue<TextDecoration>? decoration;

  EdgeInsetsGeometry? padding;

  ButtonVariantStyle merge(ButtonVariantStyle? fallback);

/// Flag tile for a country.
///
/// Unknown codes render as an empty box of the requested size, keeping the
/// surrounding layout intact. With no theme builder, flags draw as Unicode
/// regional-indicator emoji (no assets, no extra dependency); provide
/// [CountryFlagTheme.builder] for real artwork.
class CountryFlag extends StatelessWidget {
/// Creates a flag for [country] (null renders an empty box).
  const CountryFlag(this.country, {super.key, this.width, this.height, this.shape, this.theme});
/// Creates a flag from an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. `US`).
  CountryFlag.fromCountryCode(String countryCode, {super.key, this.width, this.height, this.shape, this.theme});
/// Creates a flag from an ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. `USD`); the first
/// table match wins when countries share a currency.
  CountryFlag.fromCurrencyCode(String currencyCode, {super.key, this.width, this.height, this.shape, this.theme});
/// Creates a flag from an international dial code (e.g. `+81`); the first
/// table match wins when countries share a prefix.
  CountryFlag.fromPhonePrefix(String prefix, {super.key, this.width, this.height, this.shape, this.theme});
/// Draws [details] as a regional-indicator emoji pair, scaled to fit.
///
/// This is the default artwork and stays public so custom builders can
/// defer to it for uncovered countries.
  static Widget emojiBuilder(BuildContext context, CountryFlagDetails details);
/// Country to draw, or null for an empty box.
  Country? country;
/// Flag width override; null falls back to the theme (24, scaled).
  double? width;
/// Flag height override; null falls back to the theme (18, scaled).
  double? height;
/// Clip shape override; null falls back to the theme (unclipped).
  ShapeBorder? shape;
/// Widget-leg theme override, merged over the other legs.
  CountryFlagTheme? theme;
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}

/// A multi-line text input.
///
/// A thin, opinionated [Input]: three lines tall, vertically centred content,
/// and a multiline keyboard. Everything else — controller, validation, form
/// participation, features, the focus ring, the theme legs — is `Input`'s.
///
/// ```dart
/// TextArea(hintText: 'Type your message here...', minLines: 3);
/// ```
///
/// The old drag-resize handle is gone: resizing a field is a layout decision
/// (`minLines`/`maxLines`/`expands`) that a rebuild already expresses, and the
/// handle could not work in the direction the box was not laid out in.
class TextArea extends StatelessWidget {
/// Creates a multi-line text input.
  const TextArea({super.key, this.controller, this.initialValue, this.focusNode, this.undoController, this.statesController, this.hintText, this.placeholder, this.textAlign = TextAlign.start, this.textCapitalization = TextCapitalization.sentences, this.style, this.keyboardType, this.minLines = textAreaMinLines, this.maxLines = textAreaMaxLines, this.expands = false, this.maxLength, this.maxLengthEnforcement, this.padding, this.decoration, this.border, this.borderRadius, this.filled, this.readOnly = false, this.enabled = true, this.autofocus = false, this.autocorrect = true, this.enableSuggestions = true, this.cursorColor, this.scrollPadding = const EdgeInsets.all(20), this.features = const <InputFeature>[], this.validator, this.autovalidateMode = FormValidationMode.changed, this.onChanged, this.onSubmitted, this.onEditingComplete, this.theme});
/// Lines shown when neither is given.
  static const int textAreaMinLines = 3;
/// Cap of the auto-grown field; null lets it grow with the content.
  static const int? textAreaMaxLines = null;
  TextEditingController? controller;
  String? initialValue;
  FocusNode? focusNode;
  UndoHistoryController? undoController;
  WidgetStatesController? statesController;
  String? hintText;
  Widget? placeholder;
  TextAlign textAlign;
  TextCapitalization textCapitalization;
  TextStyle? style;
  TextInputType? keyboardType;
/// Smallest height, in lines; defaults to [textAreaMinLines].
  int? minLines;
/// Largest height, in lines; defaults to [textAreaMaxLines].
  int? maxLines;
/// Whether the field fills its parent instead of growing.
  bool expands;
  int? maxLength;
  MaxLengthEnforcement? maxLengthEnforcement;
  EdgeInsetsGeometry? padding;
  BoxDecoration? decoration;
  Border? border;
  BorderRadiusGeometry? borderRadius;
  bool? filled;
  bool readOnly;
  bool enabled;
  bool autofocus;
  bool autocorrect;
  bool enableSuggestions;
  Color? cursorColor;
  EdgeInsets scrollPadding;
  List<InputFeature> features;
  String? Function(String? value)? validator;
  FormValidationMode autovalidateMode;
  ValueChanged<String>? onChanged;
  ValueChanged<String>? onSubmitted;
  VoidCallback? onEditingComplete;
/// Widget-leg [InputTheme] override.
  InputTheme? theme;
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}
/// Fails when the number is missing, or has no country or no digits.
///
/// No format/length rule is invented: the old validator checked the same two
/// conditions.
class PhoneNumberValidator extends Validator<PhoneNumber> {
/// Creates a phone number validator.
  const PhoneNumberValidator({this.invalidMessage, this.emptyMessage});
/// Failure text for a country-less or empty number; null uses
/// `formPhoneNumberInvalid`.
  String? invalidMessage;
/// Failure text for a null value; null uses `formPhoneNumberEmpty`.
  String? emptyMessage;
  FutureOr<ValidationResult?> validate(BuildContext context, PhoneNumber? value, FormValidationMode lifecycle);
  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;
}
/// A country selector plus a number field (an optional dial-code prefix plus
/// the national number). `onChanged` reports a [PhoneNumber] whenever either
/// side changes, and null while the number is empty.
class PhoneInput extends StatefulWidget {
  const PhoneInput({super.key, this.initialCountry, this.initialValue, this.onChanged, this.controller, this.onlyNumber = true, this.countries, this.searchPlaceholder, this.theme});
/// Country selected when [initialValue] carries none.
  Country? initialCountry;
/// Initial country + national number.
  PhoneNumber? initialValue;
/// Called with the next value; null while the number is empty.
  ValueChanged<PhoneNumber?>? onChanged;
/// External text controller for the national number. When null the widget
/// owns one seeded from [initialValue].
  TextEditingController? controller;
/// Whether the number field accepts digits only.
  bool onlyNumber;
/// Rows offered by the selector; null uses the full ISO table.
  List<CountryInfo>? countries;
/// Placeholder of the selector's search field.
  Widget? searchPlaceholder;
/// Widget-leg style override, merged on top of the component/app/defaults.
  PhoneInputTheme? theme;
  State<PhoneInput> createState();
}

/// Theme data for the `phone_input` component.
///
/// Every field is nullable: an override leg sets only what it changes and
/// [merge] keeps the lower leg's remaining fields.
class PhoneInputTheme extends ComponentThemeData implements Mergeable<PhoneInputTheme> {
/// Creates a phone input theme.
  const PhoneInputTheme({super.themeDensity, super.themeSpacing, super.themeShadows, this.inputPadding, this.maxWidth, this.selectWidth, this.popupConstraints, this.flagWidth, this.flagHeight, this.flagGap, this.fieldGap, this.countryGap});
/// Padding inside the number field; density-scaled (upstream `px-3 py-2`).
  EdgeInsetsGeometry? inputPadding;
/// Maximum width of the number field.
  double? maxWidth;
/// Width of the country selector (the popup is trigger-wide).
  double? selectWidth;
/// Constraints of the country popup.
  BoxConstraints? popupConstraints;
/// Flag width in the trigger and in popup rows.
  double? flagWidth;
/// Flag height in the trigger and in popup rows.
  double? flagHeight;
/// Gap between a flag and the dial code / country name.
  double? flagGap;
/// Gap between the country selector and the number field.
///
/// The group is one joined box: half of this value pads each side of the
/// hairline divider between the trigger and the field.
  double? fieldGap;
/// Gap between the country name and its dial code in popup rows.
  double? countryGap;
/// First-non-null-wins merge; the receiver (higher-priority leg) wins.
  PhoneInputTheme merge(PhoneInputTheme? fallback);
/// Dimensions are lerped; box constraints step at `t = 0.5`.
  static PhoneInputTheme lerp(PhoneInputTheme a, PhoneInputTheme b, double t);
  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;
}
