/// A binding that reads a value out of the model and matches it through a
/// [FilterField].
class TypedFilterBinding<TModel, TValue> extends FilterBinding<TModel> {
/// Creates a typed binding.
  const TypedFilterBinding({required this.field, required this.selector});
/// Field holding the selected value.
  FilterField<TValue> field;
/// Reads the candidate value from the model.
  TValue? Function(TModel model) selector;
  bool matches(FilterState state, TModel model);
}
/// Value helpers on [FilterState] (readability, counting, typed access).
extension FilterStateExtensions on FilterState {
/// Whether anything is filtered.
  bool get hasActiveFilters;
/// How many filters are active (search, sort, date, chips, custom values).
  int get activeFilterCount;
/// Returns a copy without the chip identified by [chipKey].
  FilterState withoutChip(String chipKey);
/// Returns a copy with the parts selected by [policy] reset.
  FilterState cleared({FilterClearPolicy policy = const FilterClearPolicy()});
/// The custom value stored under [key], or null when absent/mistyped.
  T? customValue<T>(String key);
/// Stores [value] under [key]; inactive values remove the key.
  FilterState setCustomValue(String key, Object? value);
/// The value selected for [field], or null.
  T? valueOf<T>(FilterField<T> field);
/// Selects [value] for [field] (null clears it).
  FilterState setValue<T>(FilterField<T> field, T? value);
/// The active matcher id of [field], falling back to its default/first.
  String? matcherIdOf<T>(FilterField<T> field);
/// Selects a matcher id for [field]; unknown ids and empty option lists
/// leave the state unchanged (the old code returned a copy that stored
/// nothing).
  FilterState setMatcherIdOf<T>(FilterField<T> field, String? matcherId);
/// The active matcher option of [field], or null when it has none.
  FilterMatcherOption<T>? matcherOptionOf<T>(FilterField<T> field);
/// The matcher that applies to [field]: the selected option or [FilterField.matcher].
  FilterMatcher<T>? matcherOf<T>(FilterField<T> field);
/// Whether [candidate] passes [field]'s active selection (unset matches all).
  bool matchesValue<T>(FilterField<T> field, Object? candidate);
/// Whether [model] passes every binding.
  bool matchesModel<TModel>(TModel model, Iterable<FilterBinding<TModel>> bindings);
/// The items of [source] that pass every binding.
  Iterable<TModel> whereMatches<TModel>(Iterable<TModel> source, Iterable<FilterBinding<TModel>> bindings);
}
/// One custom filter entry: [id] identifies it, [builder] renders it.
class FilterCustomFilter {
/// Creates a custom filter.
  const FilterCustomFilter({required this.id, required this.builder});
/// Stable id.
  String id;
/// Renders the filter for the current state.
  FilterCustomFilterBuilder builder;
/// Creates a filter backed by a [FilterField], reading its value from the
/// state and writing changes back.
  static FilterCustomFilter typed<T>({required FilterField<T> field, required FilterTypedCustomFilterBuilder<T> builder});
}
/// One titled group of custom filters.
class FilterGroup {
/// Creates a group.
  const FilterGroup({required this.id, required this.title, this.filterIds = const <String>[], this.itemBuilder});
/// Stable id.
  String id;
/// Group heading.
  String title;
/// Custom filter ids that belong to this group.
  List<String> filterIds;
/// Optional per-item renderer; when null the filter's own builder is used.
  FilterCustomFilterBuilder? itemBuilder;
}
/// Renders custom filters under [FilterGroup] headers.
///
/// Every filter renders exactly once: grouped ids under their group, all
/// other ids (and [trailing] controls) in a final ungrouped wrap. With an
/// empty [groups] list this is the flat control wrap.
class FilterBarGroupedContent extends StatelessWidget {
/// Creates the grouped (or flat) filter content.
  const FilterBarGroupedContent({super.key, required this.state, required this.onChanged, required this.groups, required this.customFilters, this.trailing = const <Widget>[], this.spacing = 12, this.runSpacing = 8});
/// Current filter state.
  FilterState state;
/// Receives the next state from a custom filter.
  FilterStateChanged onChanged;
/// Groups to render; empty renders [customFilters] and [trailing] flat.
  List<FilterGroup> groups;
/// Custom filters offered by the bar.
  List<FilterCustomFilter> customFilters;
/// Controls appended after the groups (sort/date/trailing widgets).
  List<Widget> trailing;
/// Gap between controls on the same run.
  double spacing;
/// Gap between wrapped runs.
  double runSpacing;
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}
/// Immutable value of every filter a `filter_bar` carries.
///
/// `copyWith` uses a sentinel for the nullable fields so `null` can be stored
/// deliberately (`sortId: null` clears the sort).
class FilterState {
/// Free-text query.
  String search;
/// Selected sort option id, or null.
  String? sortId;
/// Selected date span, or null.
  FilterDateRange? dateRange;
/// Removable filter chips.
  List<FilterChipData> chips;
/// Custom filter values keyed by field id (matcher ids included).
  Map<String, Object?> customFilters;
/// Creates a filter state.
  const FilterState({this.search = '', this.sortId, this.dateRange, this.chips = const <FilterChipData>[], this.customFilters = const <String, Object?>{}});
/// Returns a copy; the sentinel keeps explicit nulls.
  FilterState copyWith({String? search, Object? sortId = _sentinel, Object? dateRange = _sentinel, List<FilterChipData>? chips, Object? customFilters = _sentinel});
  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;
}
/// One removable chip: [key] identifies it, [label] is what users read.
class FilterChipData {
/// Creates a chip.
  const FilterChipData({required this.key, required this.label});
/// Stable identity used by [FilterStateExtensions.withoutChip].
  String key;
/// Chip text.
  String label;
  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;
}
/// A start/end date span; either end may be null.
class FilterDateRange {
/// Creates a date range.
  const FilterDateRange({this.start, this.end});
/// First day, or null.
  DateTime? start;
/// Last day, or null.
  DateTime? end;
/// Whether both ends are null.
  bool get isEmpty;
  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;
}
/// One sort dropdown option.
class FilterSortOption {
/// Creates a sort option.
  const FilterSortOption({required this.id, required this.label});
/// Stable id stored in [FilterState.sortId].
  String id;
/// Dropdown text.
  String label;
  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;
}
/// One reusable matching rule.
class FilterMatcher<T> {
/// Creates a matcher from its callback.
  const FilterMatcher(this._matches);
/// Whether [candidate] passes the rule for [selected].
  bool matches(T selected, Object? candidate);
}
/// The built-in matcher factories.
abstract class FilterMatchers {
/// `candidate == selected`.
  static FilterMatcher<T> exact<T>();
/// Substring match; case-insensitive by default.
  static FilterMatcher<String> contains({bool caseSensitive = false});
/// SQL-LIKE match: `%` is any run, `_` one character.
  static FilterMatcher<String> like({bool caseSensitive = false});
/// Prefix match; case-insensitive by default.
  static FilterMatcher<String> startsWith({bool caseSensitive = false});
/// Suffix match; case-insensitive by default.
  static FilterMatcher<String> endsWith({bool caseSensitive = false});
/// Membership in a stored collection.
  static FilterMatcher<Iterable<T>> anyOf<T>();
/// Membership in a stored set.
  static FilterMatcher<Set<T>> inSet<T>();
/// `candidate > selected`. A candidate of another type never matches (the
/// old check accepted any `Comparable<Object>` and threw when the runtime
/// types differed, e.g. an int selection against a String candidate).
  static FilterMatcher<T> greaterThan<T extends Comparable<Object>>();
/// `candidate < selected`; see [greaterThan] for the type guard.
  static FilterMatcher<T> lessThan<T extends Comparable<Object>>();
}
/// One selectable matcher of a [FilterField].
class FilterMatcherOption<T> {
/// Creates a matcher option.
  const FilterMatcherOption({required this.id, required this.label, required this.matcher});
/// Stable id stored by `setMatcherIdOf`.
  String id;
/// Label shown by a matcher picker.
  String label;
/// The rule this option selects.
  FilterMatcher<T> matcher;
}
/// A typed custom filter keyed by [id].
class FilterField<T> {
/// Creates a filter field.
  const FilterField({required this.id, this.label, this.matcher, this.matchers = const [], this.defaultMatcherId});
/// Key under which the value is stored in `customFilters`.
  String id;
/// Optional display label.
  String? label;
/// Fallback matcher when [matchers] is empty.
  FilterMatcher<T>? matcher;
/// Selectable matchers; empty means a single [matcher].
  List<FilterMatcherOption<T>> matchers;
/// Matcher selected until the user picks another.
  String? defaultMatcherId;
}
/// Tests one model against one [FilterState].
abstract class FilterBinding<TModel> {
/// Creates a binding.
  const FilterBinding();
/// Whether [model] passes this binding under [state].
  bool matches(FilterState state, TModel model);
}
/// Theme data for the `filter_bar` component.
///
/// Every field is nullable: an override leg sets only what it changes and
/// [merge] keeps the lower leg's remaining fields.
class FilterBarTheme extends ComponentThemeData implements Mergeable<FilterBarTheme> {
/// Creates a filter bar theme.
  const FilterBarTheme({super.themeDensity, super.themeSpacing, super.themeShadows, this.spacing, this.runSpacing, this.searchWidth, this.controlWidth, this.dense});
/// Gap between controls on the same run.
  double? spacing;
/// Gap between wrapped runs.
  double? runSpacing;
/// Width of the search field.
  double? searchWidth;
/// Width of the sort and date controls.
  double? controlWidth;
/// Compact paddings and small buttons.
  bool? dense;
/// First-non-null-wins merge; the receiver (higher-priority leg) wins.
  FilterBarTheme merge(FilterBarTheme? fallback);
  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;
}
/// Token-derived defaults: 12px spacing, 8px run spacing, 220px search,
/// 180px sort/date controls, comfortable density.
const FilterBarTheme filterBarDefaults = FilterBarTheme(spacing: 12, runSpacing: 8, searchWidth: 220, controlWidth: 180, dense: false);
/// Boolean state getters for a `Set<WidgetState>`.
extension WidgetStateExtension on Set<WidgetState> {
/// Whether the widget is disabled.
  bool get disabled;
/// Whether the widget is in an error state.
  bool get error;
/// Whether the widget is selected.
  bool get selected;
/// Whether the widget is pressed.
  bool get pressed;
/// Whether the widget is hovered.
  bool get hovered;
/// Whether the widget is focused.
  bool get focused;
}
/// The set of interactive states propagated through the tree.
class WidgetStatesData {
/// The current states.
  Set<WidgetState> states;
/// Creates widget state data.
  const WidgetStatesData(this.states);
  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;
  String toString();
}
/// Provides [WidgetStatesData] to descendants through `Data`.
///
/// Combines static [states], an optional [controller] and (unless [inherit]
/// is false) the states of an ancestor provider. [WidgetStatesProvider.
/// boundary] stops inheritance entirely.
class WidgetStatesProvider extends StatelessWidget {
/// Optional controller whose states are merged in.
  WidgetStatesController? controller;
/// Static states to provide.
  Set<WidgetState>? states;
/// The child that can read the provided states.
  Widget child;
/// Whether ancestor provider states are merged in.
  bool inherit;
/// Whether this provider blocks ancestor states.
  bool boundary;
/// Creates a states provider.
  const WidgetStatesProvider({super.key, this.controller, required this.child, this.states = const {}, this.inherit = true});
/// Creates a provider that blocks ancestor states.
  const WidgetStatesProvider.boundary({super.key, required this.child});
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}
/// A widget that shows one of several children depending on the ambient
/// [WidgetStatesData].
///
/// Three constructors: the default one takes explicit per-state widgets, the
/// `.map()` one takes a state-to-widget map and `.builder()` one derives the
/// widget from the states set.
abstract class StatedWidget extends StatelessWidget {
/// State priority order used by the default constructor.
  static const List<WidgetState> defaultStateOrder = [WidgetState.disabled, WidgetState.error, WidgetState.selected, WidgetState.pressed, WidgetState.hovered, WidgetState.focused];
/// Shows an explicit widget per state, in [order] priority.
  factory StatedWidget({Key? key, required Widget child, List<WidgetState> order, Widget? disabled, Widget? selected, Widget? pressed, Widget? hovered, Widget? focused, Widget? error});
/// Shows the widget mapped to the first active state.
  factory StatedWidget.map({Key? key, required Map<Object, Widget> states, Widget? child});
/// Builds the widget from the active states set.
  factory StatedWidget.builder({Key? key, required Widget Function(BuildContext context, Set<WidgetState> states) builder});
}

class FadeScrollTheme extends ComponentThemeData implements Mergeable<FadeScrollTheme> {

  double? endOffset;
/// Creates a [FadeScrollTheme].
  const FadeScrollTheme({super.themeDensity, super.themeSpacing, super.themeShadows, this.startOffset, this.endOffset});
/// Returns a copy with the given fields replaced.
  FadeScrollTheme copyWith({ValueGetter<double?>? startOffset, ValueGetter<double?>? endOffset});
/// First-non-null-wins merge; the receiver (higher-priority leg) wins.
  FadeScrollTheme merge(FadeScrollTheme? fallback);
  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;
}
/// Fades the edges of [child] while [controller] reports hidden content.
class FadeScroll extends StatefulWidget {

  double? startOffset;
/// Fade length from the end edge. Defaults to 0 (no end fade).
  double? endOffset;
/// The scrollable child.
  Widget child;
/// Controller monitored for the scroll position.
  ScrollController controller;
/// Creates a fade scroll widget.
  const FadeScroll({super.key, this.startOffset, this.endOffset, required this.child, required this.controller});
  State<FadeScroll> createState();
}
/// A cross-axis size for an edge-anchored panel, resolved against the
/// available cross-axis extent.
///
/// Supports arithmetic: `AxisSize.fraction(0.5) + AxisSize.fixed(40)`.
abstract class AxisSize {
/// Const constructor for subclasses.
  const AxisSize();
/// A fixed number of logical pixels.
  factory AxisSize.fixed(double size);
/// A [fraction] (0..1) of the available cross-axis extent.
  factory AxisSize.fraction(double fraction);
/// Resolves this size against the [available] cross-axis extent.
  double resolve(double available);
/// Sum of two sizes.
  AxisSize operator +(AxisSize other);
/// Difference of two sizes.
  AxisSize operator -(AxisSize other);
/// Scales this size by [factor].
  AxisSize operator *(double factor);
/// Divides this size by [factor].
  AxisSize operator /(double factor);
}
/// A fixed number of logical pixels.
class FixedAxisSize extends AxisSize {
/// Creates a fixed axis size.
  const FixedAxisSize(this.size);
/// The size in logical pixels.
  double size;
  double resolve(double available);
}
/// A fraction (0..1) of the available extent.
class FractionAxisSize extends AxisSize {
/// Creates a fractional axis size.
  const FractionAxisSize(this.fraction);
/// The fraction of the available extent.
  double fraction;
  double resolve(double available);
}
/// Sum of two [AxisSize]s.
class AdditiveAxisSize extends AxisSize {
/// Creates an additive axis size.
  const AdditiveAxisSize(this.a, this.b);
/// The left operand.
  AxisSize a;
/// The right operand.
  AxisSize b;
  double resolve(double available);
}
/// Difference of two [AxisSize]s.
class SubtractedAxisSize extends AxisSize {
/// Creates a subtracted axis size.
  const SubtractedAxisSize(this.a, this.b);
/// The left operand.
  AxisSize a;
/// The right operand.
  AxisSize b;
  double resolve(double available);
}
/// An [AxisSize] scaled by a scalar factor.
class MultipliedAxisSize extends AxisSize {
/// Creates a multiplied axis size.
  const MultipliedAxisSize(this.size, this.factor);
/// The operand.
  AxisSize size;
/// The scalar factor.
  double factor;
  double resolve(double available);
}
/// An [AxisSize] divided by a scalar factor.
class DividedAxisSize extends AxisSize {
/// Creates a divided axis size.
  const DividedAxisSize(this.size, this.factor);
/// The operand.
  AxisSize size;
/// The scalar divisor.
  double factor;
  double resolve(double available);
}
/// Parses a hex colour into a [Color].
///
/// Accepts `#RGB`, `#RRGGBB` and the 8-digit `#AARRGGBB` form produced by
/// `colorToHex(…, showAlpha: true)`; the leading `#` and a `0x` prefix are
/// both optional. Returns null for anything else (wrong length, 4-digit
/// shorthand, non-hex characters).
Color? colorFromHex(String text);
/// WCAG 2.1 contrast ratio between [a] and [b]: 1.0 for equal colours, 21.0
/// for black against white. Alpha is ignored; both colours count as opaque.
double contrastRatio(Color a, Color b);
/// Picks whichever of [light] and [dark] contrasts more with [background].
///
/// This is the rule used to derive `destructiveForeground` when a theme does
/// not define it: a dark `destructive` gets [light], a light one gets [dark].
/// Ties prefer [light].
Color pickContrastingColor(Color background, {Color light = const Color(0xFFFFFFFF), Color dark = const Color(0xFF000000)});
/// Whether [color] is light enough that dark content is the readable choice
/// by default (relative luminance at or above [threshold]).
bool isLightColor(Color color, {double threshold = 0.5});
/// Manages a set of open popovers: show, close, update and dispose.
class PopoverController extends ChangeNotifier {
/// Whether any managed popover is open and not yet completed.
  bool get hasOpenPopover;
/// Whether any managed popover is mounted with an animation in progress.
  bool get hasMountedPopover;
/// Unmodifiable view of the currently open popovers.
  Iterable<Popover> get openPopovers;
/// Shows a popover and completes with its result.
///
/// When [closeOthers] is true the currently open popovers are closed first.
  Future<T?> show<T>({required BuildContext context, required WidgetBuilder builder, required AlignmentGeometry alignment, AlignmentGeometry? anchorAlignment, PopoverConstraint widthConstraint = PopoverConstraint.flexible, PopoverConstraint heightConstraint = PopoverConstraint.flexible, bool modal = true, bool closeOthers = true, Offset? offset, GlobalKey<OverlayHandlerStateMixin>? key, Object? regionGroupId, AlignmentGeometry? transitionAlignment, bool consumeOutsideTaps = true, EdgeInsetsGeometry? margin, ValueChanged<PopoverOverlayWidgetState>? onTickFollow, bool follow = true, bool allowInvertHorizontal = true, bool allowInvertVertical = true, bool dismissBackdropFocus = true, Duration? showDuration, Duration? hideDuration, OverlayBarrier? overlayBarrier, OverlayHandler? handler});
/// Closes all managed popovers, optionally without animation.
  void close([bool immediate = false]);
/// Schedules closure of all managed popovers for the next frame.
  void closeLater();
/// Updates the anchor context of every open popover.
  set anchorContext(BuildContext value);
/// Updates the alignment of every open popover.
  set alignment(AlignmentGeometry value);
/// Updates the anchor alignment of every open popover.
  set anchorAlignment(AlignmentGeometry value);
/// Updates the width constraint of every open popover.
  set widthConstraint(PopoverConstraint value);
/// Updates the height constraint of every open popover.
  set heightConstraint(PopoverConstraint value);
/// Updates the margin of every open popover.
  set margin(EdgeInsets value);
/// Updates the follow flag of every open popover.
  set follow(bool value);
/// Updates the offset of every open popover.
  set offset(Offset? value);
/// Updates horizontal inversion permission of every open popover.
  set allowInvertHorizontal(bool value);
/// Updates vertical inversion permission of every open popover.
  set allowInvertVertical(bool value);
/// Schedules closure of all popovers (used on dispose).
  void disposePopovers();
  void dispose();
}
/// Constrains the child to a share of the available width and aligns it.
///
/// ```dart
/// FractionalAlignBox(
///   factor: 0.5,
///   alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerEnd.resolve(textDirection),
///   child: const Text('at most half as wide as the row'),
/// )
/// ```
class FractionalAlignBox extends SingleChildRenderObjectWidget {
/// Creates a fraction-limited, aligned box.
  const FractionalAlignBox({super.key, required this.factor, required this.alignment, required super.child});
/// Share of the incoming width the child may use (`0..1`). A non-finite
/// incoming width (unbounded rows) ignores the factor.
  double factor;
/// Where the child sits inside the box; resolved against the ambient
/// direction.
  AlignmentGeometry alignment;
  RenderObject createRenderObject(BuildContext context);
  void updateRenderObject(BuildContext context, FractionalAlignBoxRender renderObject);
}
/// The render box behind [FractionalAlignBox]: lays the child out under
/// `maxWidth * factor`, sizes itself from the constraints and positions the
/// child with the resolved alignment.
class FractionalAlignBoxRender extends RenderShiftedBox {
/// Creates the render box.
  FractionalAlignBoxRender({required this._factor, required this._alignment, RenderBox? child});
/// Share of the incoming width the child may use.
  double get factor;
  set factor(double value);
/// Position of the child inside this box.
  Alignment get alignment;
  set alignment(Alignment value);
  void performLayout();
  Size computeDryLayout(covariant BoxConstraints constraints);
}

  Widget? trailing;

}
/// One row of the [countryTable]: display name, ISO code, dial code and
/// ISO 4217 currency code for a country.
class CountryInfo {
/// Creates a country info row.
  const CountryInfo(this.code, this.dialCode, this.currencyCode, this.name, {this.primary = false});
/// ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. `US`.
  String code;
/// International dial code with `+` prefix, e.g. `+1`.
  String dialCode;
/// ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. `USD`.
  String currencyCode;
/// English display name, e.g. `United States`.
  String name;
/// Whether this row is the primary country of a shared dial code.
///
/// Typed-prefix detection uses it as the tie-break between rows that share
/// a dial code (`+1` → `US`, `+44` → `GB`, `+590` → `GP`, ...); a current
/// selection sharing the code still wins.
  bool primary;
/// This row as the minimal [Country] value type.
  Country get country;
  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;
  String toString();
}

/// First [countryTable] row whose [CountryInfo.code] matches [code]
/// (case-insensitive), or null for unknown codes.
CountryInfo? countryInfoForCode(String code);
/// First [countryTable] row whose [CountryInfo.currencyCode] matches
/// [currencyCode] (case-insensitive), or null.
CountryInfo? countryInfoForCurrency(String currencyCode);
/// First [countryTable] row whose [CountryInfo.dialCode] matches [prefix]
/// (a leading `+` is optional), or null.
CountryInfo? countryInfoForDialCode(String prefix);
/// Regional-indicator emoji for an ISO [code] (e.g. `US` -> flag emoji).
/// Returns an empty string when [code] is not two ASCII letters.
String flagEmojiForCode(String code);
/// Error text for [ComponentLocalizations].
///
/// Applied by `ComponentLocalizations`; every getter has an English default and
/// translated locale tables may override it.
mixin ComponentLocalizationsError {
/// Default title of an error with no more specific mapping.
  String get errorSomethingWentWrong;
/// Default message of an error with no more specific mapping.
  String get errorUnexpectedMessage;
/// Label of a retry action.
  String get errorActionRetry;
/// Label of a report action.
  String get errorActionReport;
/// Label of a navigate-back action.
  String get errorActionBack;
/// Label of a log-in action.
  String get errorActionLogin;
/// Label of an open-settings action.
  String get errorActionSettings;
/// Label of a contact-support action.
  String get errorActionContactSupport;
/// Title for HTTP 400.
  String get errorBadRequest;
/// Message for HTTP 400.
  String get errorBadRequestMessage;
/// Title for HTTP 401.
  String get errorUnauthorized;
/// Message for HTTP 401 and for auth failures.
  String get errorLoginRequiredMessage;
/// Title for HTTP 403.
  String get errorAccessDenied;
/// Message for HTTP 403.
  String get errorAccessDeniedMessage;
/// Title for HTTP 404.
  String get errorNotFound;
/// Message for HTTP 404.
  String get errorNotFoundMessage;
/// Title for HTTP 409.
  String get errorConflict;
/// Message for HTTP 409.
  String get errorConflictMessage;
/// Title for HTTP 422.
  String get errorInvalidData;
/// Message for HTTP 422.
  String get errorInvalidDataMessage;
/// Title for HTTP 429.
  String get errorTooManyRequests;
/// Message for HTTP 429.
  String get errorTooManyRequestsMessage;
/// Title for HTTP 5xx and other server failures.
  String get errorServerError;
/// Message for HTTP 5xx and other server failures.
  String get errorServerErrorMessage;
/// Title of a timed-out request.
  String get errorRequestTimedOut;
/// Message of a timed-out request.
  String get errorRequestTimedOutMessage;
/// Title of an authentication failure.
  String get errorAuthenticationRequired;
/// Title of a validation failure.
  String get errorInvalidInput;
/// Message of a validation failure.
  String get errorReviewFieldsMessage;
/// Title of a platform-channel failure.
  String get errorPlatformError;
/// Message of a platform-channel failure.
  String get errorDeviceErrorMessage;
/// Title of a connection failure.
  String get errorConnectionFailed;
/// Message of a connection failure.
  String get errorConnectionFailedMessage;
/// Title of a secure-connection failure.
  String get errorSecureConnectionFailed;
/// Message of a secure-connection failure.
  String get errorSecureConnectionMessage;
}

/// One component of a calendar date.
///
/// Date pickers use it to order and label their fields, and as the key type of
/// the "which components are set" map. The concepts here are language-neutral;
/// their *labels* are locale data, via
/// [ComponentLocalizationsExtensions.getDatePartAbbreviation].
enum DatePart { year, month, day }
/// One component of a clock time.
///
/// Used to order and label the fields of a time picker; see [DatePart] for the
/// same idea applied to dates.
enum TimePart { hour, minute, second }
/// One component of a duration.
///
/// Used to order and label the fields of a duration picker; see [DatePart] for
/// the same idea applied to dates.
enum DurationPart { day, hour, minute, second }

/// Loads [ComponentLocalizations] for every locale that ships translated data.
///
/// Matching is on the language code, so `de_AT` resolves to German and
/// `zh_TW` to the traditional-Chinese table.
class ComponentLocalizationsDelegate extends LocalizationsDelegate<ComponentLocalizations> {
/// Creates the delegate.
  const ComponentLocalizationsDelegate();
  bool isSupported(Locale locale);
  Future<ComponentLocalizations> load(Locale locale);
  bool shouldReload(ComponentLocalizationsDelegate old);
}
/// Returns the translated [ComponentLocalizations] for [locale].
///
/// Locales without their own table fall back to the English defaults, so this
/// is total: it never throws.
ComponentLocalizations lookupComponentLocalizations(Locale locale);

/// Formatting helpers built on the [ComponentLocalizations] strings.
///
/// The words come from the localizations instance; the separators, padding and
/// 12/24-hour convention come from the arguments.
extension ComponentLocalizationsExtensions on ComponentLocalizations {
/// The order date fields are presented in unless the app overrides it.
///
/// Month/day/year, matching the upstream and platform defaults.
  List<DatePart> get datePartsOrder;
/// Abbreviation for the year component, e.g. `YYYY`.
  String get dateYearAbbreviation;
/// Abbreviation for the month component, e.g. `MM`.
  String get dateMonthAbbreviation;
/// Abbreviation for the day component, e.g. `DD`.
  String get dateDayAbbreviation;
/// The placeholder for one date field, e.g. `MM` for [DatePart.month].
  String getDatePartAbbreviation(DatePart part);
/// The placeholder for one clock field, e.g. `HH` for [TimePart.hour].
  String getTimePartAbbreviation(TimePart part);
/// The placeholder for one duration field, e.g. `HH` for [DurationPart.hour].
///
/// Shares [getTimePartAbbreviation]'s placeholders: a duration has no separate
/// notation, so `DD` doubles as the day placeholder.
  String getDurationPartAbbreviation(DurationPart part);
/// Formats [value] without a decimal point when it is a whole number.
///
/// `1500.0` renders as `1500`, `1.5` as `1.5`.
  String formatNumber(double value);
/// Renders [dateTime] as a localized date, optionally followed by the time.
///
/// [showDate] drops the date part and [showTime] drops the time part;
/// [showSeconds] adds seconds and [use24HourFormat] picks the clock
/// convention. 12-hour output appends [timeAM] or [timePM] and ignores
/// [showSeconds].
  String formatDateTime(DateTime dateTime, {bool showDate = true, bool showTime = true, bool showSeconds = false, bool use24HourFormat = true});
/// Renders [time] as a clock string with zero-padded components.
///
/// [use24HourFormat] picks the clock convention and [showSeconds] adds the
/// seconds component. 12-hour output appends [timeAM] or [timePM].
  String formatTimeOfDay(TimeOfDay time, {bool use24HourFormat = true, bool showSeconds = false});
/// Renders [duration] as a compact `1d 2h 3m 4s` string.
///
/// Each component is dropped when its flag is false, and zero components are
/// dropped regardless of the flags.
  String formatDuration(Duration duration, {bool showDays = true, bool showHours = true, bool showMinutes = true, bool showSeconds = true});
}

/// File-picker, dropzone and upload text for [ComponentLocalizations].
///
/// Flutter's ARB files have no file-upload equivalents, so these are English
/// fallbacks only: a locale may override them, but nothing else is copied in
/// here.
///
/// Applied by `ComponentLocalizations`.
mixin ComponentLocalizationsFiles {
/// `dropzone` status line while nothing is happening.
///
/// No Flutter ARB equivalent exists, so this is the English fallback only.
  String get dropzoneIdle;
/// `dropzone` status line while a drag hovers over the surface.
///
/// No Flutter ARB equivalent exists, so this is the English fallback only.
  String get dropzoneDragging;
/// `dropzone` status line while the files are being written.
///
/// No Flutter ARB equivalent exists, so this is the English fallback only.
  String get dropzoneUploading;
/// `dropzone` status line after a successful upload.
///
/// No Flutter ARB equivalent exists, so this is the English fallback only.
  String get dropzoneSuccess;
/// `dropzone` status line after a failed upload.
///
/// No Flutter ARB equivalent exists, so this is the English fallback only.
  String get dropzoneError;
/// `dropzone` status line while the surface is disabled.
///
/// No Flutter ARB equivalent exists, so this is the English fallback only.
  String get dropzoneDisabled;
/// Default `dropzone` browse action label.
///
/// No Flutter ARB equivalent exists, so this is the English fallback only.
  String get dropzoneBrowse;
/// Pick/browse label of the file surfaces.
  String get fileUploadChoose;
/// Tile label while nothing is selected.
  String get fileUploadNoFile;
/// Error shown when the platform picker threw.
  String get fileUploadPickFailed;
/// Validation: more files than the constraint allows.
  String get fileUploadTooMany;
/// Validation: one file is over the size limit.
  String get fileUploadTooLarge;
/// Validation: extension or MIME type not allowed.
  String get fileUploadInvalidType;
/// Upload failure without a file (e.g. the picker failed).
  String get fileUploadUploadFailed;
/// Upload failure for one file.
  String fileUploadUploadFailedFor(String name);
/// Status label for [FileStatus.queued].
  String get fileUploadStatusQueued;
/// Status label for [FileStatus.uploading].
  String get fileUploadStatusUploading;
/// Status label for [FileStatus.success].
  String get fileUploadStatusCompleted;
/// Status label for [FileStatus.error].
  String get fileUploadStatusFailed;
/// Type label for a file without an extension.
  String get fileUploadUnknownType;
/// Row action: remove the file.
  String get fileUploadRemove;
/// Row action: retry the upload.
  String get fileUploadRetry;
/// Row action: preview the file.
  String get fileUploadPreview;
/// Row action: download the file.
  String get fileUploadDownload;
}

/// Every user-facing string the registry components read.
///
/// One instance per locale, reached with [of]. The values here are the English
/// defaults, grouped by domain into the `localizations_<domain>.dart` mixins
/// this class applies; locales with translated data subclass it and override
/// what they translate (see [lookupComponentLocalizations]).
///
/// ```dart
/// Localizations.override(
///   context: context,
///   delegates: ComponentLocalizations.localizationsDelegates,
///   child: child,
/// );
/// Text(ComponentLocalizations.of(context).formLengthLessThan(4));
/// ```
class ComponentLocalizations with ComponentLocalizationsForm, ComponentLocalizationsOverlay, ComponentLocalizationsDateTime, ComponentLocalizationsFiles, ComponentLocalizationsMisc, ComponentLocalizationsError {
  const ComponentLocalizations(this.locale);
/// The English defaults, for code that has no [BuildContext] to call [of]
/// on.
  static const ComponentLocalizations english = ComponentLocalizations(Locale('en'));
/// The locale these strings belong to.
  Locale locale;
/// [locale] in the form `intl` expects: `language[-COUNTRY][-SCRIPT]`.
  String get localeName;
/// Loads [ComponentLocalizations] for [context]'s locale.
///
/// Falls back to English when no delegate was installed.
  static ComponentLocalizations of(BuildContext context);
/// Delegate to add to an app's `localizationsDelegates`.
  static const LocalizationsDelegate<ComponentLocalizations> delegate = ComponentLocalizationsDelegate();
/// [delegate] on its own, ready to spread into `localizationsDelegates`.
  static const List<LocalizationsDelegate<dynamic>> localizationsDelegates = <LocalizationsDelegate<dynamic>>[delegate];
/// Locales this delegate can load; must match the app's `supportedLocales`.
///
/// One entry per translated table, with [Locale('en')] first: English is the
/// base fallback, so an unknown device locale resolves to English instead of
/// the first translated table. Text direction is *not* handled here: Flutter
/// resolves it from [WidgetsLocalizations] and [Directionality].
  static const List<Locale> supportedLocales = <Locale>[Locale('en'), Locale.fromSubtags(languageCode: 'zh', scriptCode: 'Hant'), Locale('ar'), Locale('bg'), Locale('bn'), Locale('cs'), Locale('da'), Locale('de'), Locale('el'), Locale('es'), Locale('fa'), Locale('fi'), Locale('fil'), Locale('fr'), Locale('he'), Locale('hi'), Locale('hu'), Locale('id'), Locale('it'), Locale('ja'), Locale('ko'), Locale('mr'), Locale('ms'), Locale('nb'), Locale('nl'), Locale('pl'), Locale('ps'), Locale('pt'), Locale('ro'), Locale('ru'), Locale('sk'), Locale('sv'), Locale('ta'), Locale('te'), Locale('th'), Locale('tr'), Locale('uk'), Locale('ur'), Locale('vi'), Locale('zh')];
/// Resolves a device [locale] against [supported] (a `supportedLocales`
/// list), matching by **language code first**, then refining by
/// script/country:
///
/// * `en_US`, `en_GB` → the `en` entry;
/// * `de_AT` → the `de` entry;
/// * `zh_Hant*` and `zh_TW`/`zh_HK`/`zh_MO` → the `zh_Hant` entry;
/// * other `zh` regions (`zh_CN`, `zh_SG`, …) → the plain `zh` entry;
/// * an unknown language (`sw`) → the first fallback entry (`en`).
///
/// Use it as a `localeResolutionCallback` (the `app` component does) so a
/// locale whose language is supported never loses to an earlier script or
/// country entry.
  static Locale resolveLocale(Locale locale, Iterable<Locale> supported);
}

/// Nesting depth for an unordered list, provided to descendants by the `li`
/// modifier.
class UnorderedListData {
/// Creates list data at nesting level [depth] (0 = top level).
  const UnorderedListData({this.depth = 0});
/// The nesting depth, 0 for a top-level list item.
  int depth;
}
/// The bullet drawn for a list item at [depth].
///
/// The shape cycles every three levels — disc, square, triangle — so nested
/// lists stay visually distinguishable. The fill colour comes from the ambient
/// [DefaultTextStyle].
Widget getBullet(BuildContext context, int depth, double size);
/// Base of the fluent text modifiers added to every [Widget] by
/// [TextExtension].
///
/// A modifier is a widget: drop it in a tree, or call it to derive a new
/// modifier with a style override merged into the existing one.
///
/// ```dart
/// Text('Total').large.bold.muted;
/// ```
abstract class TextModifier extends StatelessWidget {
/// Creates a [TextModifier].
  const TextModifier({super.key});
/// Returns a modifier whose style is this one's style merged with the given
/// properties.
///
/// Where both define a property, the style already on this modifier wins and
/// the argument only fills gaps. Passing nothing is the identity.
  Widget call({Color? color, Color? backgroundColor, double? fontSize, FontWeight? fontWeight, FontStyle? fontStyle, double? letterSpacing, double? wordSpacing, TextBaseline? textBaseline, double? height, TextLeadingDistribution? leadingDistribution, Locale? locale, Paint? foreground, Paint? background, List<Shadow>? shadows, List<FontFeature>? fontFeatures, List<FontVariation>? fontVariations, TextDecoration? decoration, Color? decorationColor, TextDecorationStyle? decorationStyle, double? decorationThickness, String? debugLabel, String? fontFamily, List<String>? fontFamilyFallback, String? package, TextOverflow? overflow});
}
/// The default [TextModifier]: resolves its builders against the ambient
/// [Theme] and installs the result as a merged [DefaultTextStyle].
///
/// [wrapper] runs outside the style merge, so decorations and padding around
/// the text do not inherit the modifier's text style.
class WrappedText extends TextModifier {
/// Creates a modifier over [child].
  const WrappedText({super.key, this.style, this.textAlign, this.softWrap, this.overflow, this.maxLines, this.textWidthBasis, this.wrapper, required this.child});
/// Style builder installed as the default text style.
  WrappedTextDataBuilder<TextStyle>? style;
/// Text alignment builder.
  WrappedTextDataBuilder<TextAlign>? textAlign;
/// Soft-wrap builder.
  WrappedTextDataBuilder<bool>? softWrap;
/// Overflow builder.
  WrappedTextDataBuilder<TextOverflow>? overflow;
/// Maximum line count builder.
  WrappedTextDataBuilder<int>? maxLines;
/// Text width basis builder.
  WrappedTextDataBuilder<TextWidthBasis>? textWidthBasis;
/// Extra widgets placed around the child.
  WidgetTextWrapper? wrapper;
/// The widget being modified.
  Widget child;
  Widget call({Color? color, Color? backgroundColor, double? fontSize, FontWeight? fontWeight, FontStyle? fontStyle, double? letterSpacing, double? wordSpacing, TextBaseline? textBaseline, double? height, TextLeadingDistribution? leadingDistribution, Locale? locale, Paint? foreground, Paint? background, List<Shadow>? shadows, List<FontFeature>? fontFeatures, List<FontVariation>? fontVariations, TextDecoration? decoration, Color? decorationColor, TextDecorationStyle? decorationStyle, double? decorationThickness, String? debugLabel, String? fontFamily, List<String>? fontFamilyFallback, String? package, TextOverflow? overflow});
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
/// Copies this modifier, replacing only the arguments that are given.
///
/// Each argument is a getter so a builder can be built lazily; omitting an
/// argument keeps the current value.
  WrappedText copyWith({ValueGetter<WrappedTextDataBuilder<TextStyle>?>? style, ValueGetter<WrappedTextDataBuilder<TextAlign>?>? textAlign, ValueGetter<WrappedTextDataBuilder<bool>?>? softWrap, ValueGetter<WrappedTextDataBuilder<TextOverflow>?>? overflow, ValueGetter<WrappedTextDataBuilder<int>?>? maxLines, ValueGetter<WrappedTextDataBuilder<TextWidthBasis>?>? textWidthBasis, ValueGetter<WidgetTextWrapper?>? wrapper, ValueGetter<Widget>? child});
/// Copies this modifier with [style] merged underneath the current style.
///
/// The style already set here wins wherever both define a property; [style]
/// fills in the rest. That is what makes `Text('x').large.call(fontSize: 12)`
/// keep the large size and only take the colour from the argument.
  WrappedText copyWithStyle(WrappedTextDataBuilder<TextStyle> style);
}
/// Appends an inline span to the text held by this widget.
///
/// Supports [Text] and [RichText]; anything else throws. Chaining works — each
/// call returns another appender carrying the spans collected so far.
///
/// ```dart
/// Text('Total: ').then(TextSpan(text: '\$42'));
/// ```
extension TextThenExtension on Widget {
/// Returns a widget rendering this one's text with [span] appended.
  Widget then(InlineSpan span);
}
/// The fluent text-styling API.
///
/// Every getter returns a [TextModifier], so calls chain and read left to
/// right. Modifiers resolve against the ambient [Theme], so the same
/// chain restyles itself when the theme changes.
///
/// ```dart
/// Text('Heading').h2.bold;
/// Text('Body').p.muted;
/// ```
extension TextExtension on Widget {
/// Sans-serif family.
  TextModifier get sans;
/// Monospace family.
  TextModifier get mono;
/// 12px.
  TextModifier get xSmall;
/// 14px.
  TextModifier get small;
/// 16px.
  TextModifier get base;
/// 18px.
  TextModifier get large;
/// 20px.
  TextModifier get xLarge;
/// 24px.
  TextModifier get x2Large;
/// 30px.
  TextModifier get x3Large;
/// 36px.
  TextModifier get x4Large;
/// 48px.
  TextModifier get x5Large;
/// 60px.
  TextModifier get x6Large;
/// 72px.
  TextModifier get x7Large;
/// 96px.
  TextModifier get x8Large;
/// 144px.
  TextModifier get x9Large;
/// Weight 100.
  TextModifier get thin;
/// Weight 200.
  TextModifier get extraLight;
/// Weight 300.
  TextModifier get light;
/// Weight 400.
  TextModifier get normal;
/// Weight 500.
  TextModifier get medium;
/// Weight 600.
  TextModifier get semiBold;
/// Weight 700.
  TextModifier get bold;
/// Weight 800.
  TextModifier get extraBold;
/// Weight 900.
  TextModifier get black;
/// Italic.
  TextModifier get italic;
/// Underlined.
  TextModifier get underline;
/// Muted foreground colour.
  TextModifier get muted;
/// Primary foreground colour.
  TextModifier get primaryForeground;
/// Secondary foreground colour.
  TextModifier get secondaryForeground;
/// Body foreground colour.
  TextModifier get foreground;
/// Primary foreground colour; retained name of [foreground]'s sibling.
  TextModifier get modify;
/// Heading level 1.
  TextModifier get h1;
/// Heading level 2, with a rule underneath and top margin.
  TextModifier get h2;
/// Heading level 3.
  TextModifier get h3;
/// Heading level 4.
  TextModifier get h4;
/// Paragraph, with top margin. See [firstP] for the first one on a page.
  TextModifier get p;
/// Paragraph without the top margin.
  TextModifier get firstP;
/// Block quote, with a left rule.
  TextModifier get blockQuote;
/// List item: draws a bullet and increases the nesting depth for children.
  TextModifier get li;
/// Inline code: monospace style in a rounded, muted chip.
  TextModifier get inlineCode;
/// Lead paragraph, in the muted colour.
  TextModifier get lead;
/// Large body text.
  TextModifier get textLarge;
/// Small body text.
  TextModifier get textSmall;
/// Small body text in the muted colour.
  TextModifier get textMuted;
/// One line, no wrapping.
  TextModifier get singleLine;
/// Truncates with an ellipsis.
  TextModifier get ellipsis;
/// Centres the text.
  TextModifier get textCenter;
/// Right-aligns the text.
  TextModifier get textRight;
/// Left-aligns the text.
  TextModifier get textLeft;
/// Justifies the text.
  TextModifier get textJustify;
/// Aligns to the leading edge (left in LTR).
  TextModifier get textStart;
/// Aligns to the trailing edge (right in LTR).
  TextModifier get textEnd;
}
/// One selectable row inside a [SubFocus] list.
///
/// Hovering requests sub-focus; the row paints the highlight colour while
/// focused. A row without [onTap] (or with `enabled: false`) is rendered
/// read-only: no tap target, no hover, dimmed at half opacity.
class SubFocusListItem extends StatelessWidget {
/// Creates a focusable list row.
  const SubFocusListItem({super.key, this.leading, required this.title, this.trailing, this.onTap, this.enabled, this.padding = const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 6), this.borderRadius, this.highlightColor, this.highlightedForeground, this.foreground});
/// Widget shown before [title].
  Widget? leading;
/// Primary row content.
  Widget title;
/// Widget shown after [title].
  Widget? trailing;
/// Called when the row is activated; null renders it read-only.
  VoidCallback? onTap;
/// Overrides the enabled state; null means `onTap != null`.
  bool? enabled;
/// Padding around the row.
  EdgeInsetsGeometry padding;
/// Highlight corner radius; null falls back to `theme.borderRadiusSm`.
  BorderRadius? borderRadius;
/// Background while focused; null falls back to the `accent` token.
  Color? highlightColor;
/// Text/icon colour while focused; null falls back to `accentForeground`.
  Color? highlightedForeground;
/// Text/icon colour while not focused; null falls back to `foreground`.
  Color? foreground;
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}

  AlignmentGeometry? trailingAlignment;

  const BasicLayout({super.key, this.leading, this.title, this.subtitle, this.content, this.trailing, this.leadingAlignment, this.trailingAlignment, this.titleAlignment, this.subtitleAlignment, this.contentAlignment, this.contentSpacing, this.titleSpacing, this.constraints});
  Widget build(BuildContext context);

/// A tight pressable for tab rows. Unlike `Button` it carries no minimum size
/// or padding, so strips keep their own metrics.
class TabButton extends StatelessWidget {

/// Button content, usually a label.
  Widget child;
/// Called on tap; null disables unless [enabled] is true.
  VoidCallback? onPressed;
/// Enabled override; null means `onPressed != null`.
  bool? enabled;
/// Selected state for assistive tech.
  bool selected;
/// Focus node; owned internally when null.
  FocusNode? focusNode;

  ValueChanged<bool>? onHover;
/// Called when the focus state changes.
  ValueChanged<bool>? onFocusChange;
/// Padding around [child]; null means none.
  EdgeInsetsGeometry? padding;
/// Extra keyboard shortcuts (arrow-key maps go here).
  Map<LogicalKeySet, Intent>? shortcuts;
/// Actions for [shortcuts].
  Map<Type, Action<Intent>>? actions;
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}

/// Indexing context a [TabContainer] publishes to its tab children.
class TabContainerData {
/// Creates container data.
  const TabContainerData({required this.index, required this.selected, required this.onSelect, required this.childBuilder});
/// This tab's index.
  int index;
/// The currently selected index.
  int selected;
/// Selection callback; null renders tabs disabled.
  ValueChanged<int>? onSelect;
/// Wrapper applied to each tab child.
  TabChildBuilder childBuilder;
/// Nearest ancestor data; asserts inside a tab container.
  static TabContainerData of(BuildContext context);
/// Nearest ancestor data, or null.
  static TabContainerData? maybeOf(BuildContext context);
  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;
}
/// Marker for widgets that can live in a [TabContainer].
mixin TabChild on Widget {
/// Whether the container assigns this child an index.
  bool get indexed;
}
/// A [TabChild] identified by a custom key instead of its position.
mixin KeyedTabChild<T> on TabChild {
/// The key identifying this tab.
  T get tabKey;
}
/// An indexed tab: builds through the container's `childBuilder`.
class TabItem extends StatelessWidget with TabChild {
/// Creates a tab item.
  const TabItem({super.key, required this.child});
/// The tab content.
  Widget child;
  bool get indexed;
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}
/// A [TabItem] carrying a custom [tabKey].
class KeyedTabItem<T> extends TabItem with KeyedTabChild<T> {
/// Creates a keyed tab item.
  KeyedTabItem({required T key, required super.child});
  ValueKey<T> get key;
  T get tabKey;
}
/// Assigns indices to [TabItem] children and lays them out.
///
/// Non-indexed children render as-is. [Tabs] and [TabPane] supply the upstream
/// paint through `builder`/`childBuilder`.
class TabContainer extends StatelessWidget {
/// Creates a tab container.
///
/// [builder]/[childBuilder] are explicit: app-wide defaults resolve in
/// [Tabs]/[TabPane] through `TabContainerTheme` and are forwarded here.
  const TabContainer({super.key, required this.selected, required this.onSelect, required this.children, this.builder, this.childBuilder});
/// Currently selected index.
  int selected;
/// Selection callback; null renders every tab disabled.
  ValueChanged<int>? onSelect;
/// Tab children in order.
  List<TabChild> children;
/// Layout override; null lays children in a column.
  TabBuilder? builder;
/// Per-tab wrapper override; null passes children through.
  TabChildBuilder? childBuilder;
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}
/// Coordinates the file list, validation, the upload queue and concurrency.
///
/// One queue drives every file: [addFiles] validates, [startUploads] queues
/// the non-success items up to `maxConcurrent`, and [retry] puts one failed
/// file back in line. [removeFile] cancels a queued or active upload.
class FileUploadController extends ChangeNotifier {
/// Creates a controller, optionally with [initialItems] already listed.
  FileUploadController({List<FileItem>? initialItems, this.constraints = const FileConstraints(), FileUploadMessage? message});
/// Acceptance constraints; [addFiles] enforces them unless the caller passes
/// a one-off override.
  FileConstraints constraints;
/// The current rows, in insertion order.
  List<FileItem> get items;
/// Rejections from the last [addFiles] call plus upload failures.
  List<FileError> get errors;
/// Whether any row is mid-transfer.
  bool get isUploading;
/// Whether the list has any rows.
  bool get hasItems;
/// Replaces every row; ongoing uploads are cancelled.
  void setItems(List<FileItem> items);
/// Empties the list, the errors and every upload.
  void clear();
/// Validates [files] against [constraints] (or [overrideConstraints]),
/// appends the accepted rows, replaces the validation errors and returns the
/// added files.
///
/// The old widget validated *and* the controller validated, so two different
/// constraint sets could disagree; this is the only validation site now.
  List<FileValue> addFiles(List<FileValue> files, {FileConstraints? overrideConstraints});
/// Removes [file], cancelling a queued or active upload.
  void removeFile(FileValue file);
/// Appends [error] to [errors] and notifies (used for picker failures that
/// produce no file row).
  void reportError(FileError error);
/// Replaces the row for [file] with a new status/progress.
///
/// A null [progress] clears the bar; a non-null one keeps it. The old
/// `FileUploadItem.copyWith` cleared progress on *every* call, so a status
/// change silently reset a running bar.
  void updateItem(FileValue file, FileStatus status, double? progress);
/// Starts (or restarts) uploads with [upload].
///
/// [files] limits the batch; null queues every non-success row. Rows already
/// queued or uploading are skipped, so calling this twice never double-starts
/// an upload. The callbacks are stored for [retry].
  void startUploads(FileUploadFn upload, {List<FileValue>? files, int maxConcurrent = 1, void Function(FileValue file, double progress)? onProgress, VoidCallback? onUploadStart, ValueChanged<List<FileValue>>? onComplete, ValueChanged<FileError>? onError});
/// Re-queues one failed [file] with the function and callbacks of the last
/// [startUploads] call; does nothing before one.
  void retry(FileValue file);
  void dispose();
}
/// The default row thumbnail: a Radix glyph per extension.
Widget defaultFileIcon(String extension);
class FileUploadRow extends StatelessWidget {
/// Creates a file row.
  const FileUploadRow({super.key, required this.item, this.theme, this.progress, this.statusLabels, this.onRemove, this.onRetry, this.onPreview, this.onDownload, this.thumbnail, this.iconBuilder});
/// The row's file and transfer state.
  FileItem item;
/// Widget-leg style override, merged on top of the component/app/defaults.
  FileUploadRowTheme? theme;
/// Progress indicator shown under the row; null hides it.
  Widget? progress;

  FileStatusLabels? statusLabels;
/// Removes the file.
  VoidCallback? onRemove;

  VoidCallback? onRetry;
/// Previews the file.
  VoidCallback? onPreview;
/// Downloads the file.
  VoidCallback? onDownload;

/// Checks [incoming] against [constraints], counting [existing] towards the file
/// limit.
///
/// Every rejection goes through [onError], so the caller owns the wording and
/// the localization. The old `validateFiles` built its English messages inline,
/// which shipped the same English to every locale.
FileValidationResult validateFiles({required List<FileValue> incoming, required List<FileValue> existing, FileConstraints? constraints, required String Function(FileErrorCode code, FileValue? file) onError});
/// One selected file, as the registry models it.
///
/// A platform-neutral value type: the picker component converts whatever the
/// platform hands it into this, and every downstream widget reads only this
/// shape.
class FileValue {
/// Creates a file value.
  const FileValue({required this.id, required this.name, required this.size, this.bytes, this.path, this.mimeType, this.extension, this.source});
/// Stable identity of this file inside a selection (upload state, form value).
  String id;
/// File name including the extension, as shown to the user.
  String name;
/// Size in bytes.
  int size;
/// File contents, when the picker was asked to read them.
  Uint8List? bytes;
/// Platform path, where one exists (null on the web).
  String? path;
/// MIME type, when known.
  String? mimeType;
/// Extension without the dot; derived from [name] when null.
  String? extension;
/// The platform object this came from, for callers that need it.
///
/// Deliberately `Object?` so layer 2 never names a platform type.
  Object? source;
/// Lower-cased extension without the dot; empty when there is none.
///
/// The old `resolvedExtension` used `name.split('.')`, so a name of
/// `.gitignore` reported `gitignore` as its extension. A leading dot now
/// yields empty, as does a trailing one.
  String get resolvedExtension;
/// Whether the file looks like an image: its MIME type says so, or its
/// extension is one the platforms decode natively.
  bool get isImage;
/// Extensions treated as images when no MIME type is available.
  static const Set<String> imageFileExtensions = <String>{'png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'gif', 'webp', 'bmp', 'svg', 'heic'};
  String toString();
}
/// What a picked file is doing right now.
enum FileStatus { queued, uploading, success, error }
/// One row of an upload list: a file plus its transfer state.
class FileItem {
/// Creates an upload item.
  const FileItem({required this.file, this.status = FileStatus.queued, this.progress});
/// The file this row tracks.
  FileValue file;
/// Transfer state.
  FileStatus status;
/// Upload progress in `[0, 1]`; null when unknown or not uploading.
  double? progress;
/// A copy with the given fields replaced.
///
/// Pass `resetProgress: true` to clear [progress]. The old
/// `FileUploadItem.copyWith` dropped progress on *every* call, so a progress
/// tick followed by a status change silently reset the bar.
  FileItem copyWith({FileStatus? status, double? progress, bool resetProgress = false});
  String toString();
}
/// Why a file was rejected.
enum FileErrorCode { invalidType, tooLarge, tooMany, uploadFailed }
/// One rejection produced by [validateFiles] or by the upload controller.
class FileError {
/// Creates an error.
  const FileError({required this.code, required this.message, this.file});
/// Why the file was rejected.
  FileErrorCode code;
/// User-facing message. Components build this from `ComponentLocalizations`; the
/// validation helper takes it as a parameter so it never hard-codes English.
  String message;
/// The rejected file, when the error is about a single file.
  FileValue? file;
  String toString();
}
/// Outcome of [validateFiles].
class FileValidationResult {
/// Creates a result.
  const FileValidationResult({required this.accepted, required this.errors});
/// Files that passed every check, in input order.
  List<FileValue> accepted;
/// One error per rejection.
  List<FileError> errors;
/// Whether anything was rejected.
  bool get hasErrors;
  String toString();
}
/// The acceptance constraints a file component enforces.
///
/// The old `FileUploadHelpfulInfoData` duplicated exactly these five fields so
/// the help text and the validation could not drift; one type serves both.
class FileConstraints {
/// Creates a constraint set. Every field is optional; null means "no limit".
  const FileConstraints({this.allowMultiple = true, this.maxFiles, this.maxFileSizeBytes, this.allowedExtensions, this.allowedMimeTypes});
/// Whether more than one file may be selected.
  bool allowMultiple;
/// Maximum number of files in the whole selection.
  int? maxFiles;
/// Maximum size of a single file, in bytes.
  int? maxFileSizeBytes;
/// Allowed extensions, with or without a leading dot; case-insensitive.
  List<String>? allowedExtensions;
/// Allowed MIME types; `image/*`-style wildcards are honoured.
  List<String>? allowedMimeTypes;
/// Extensions normalised to lower case without the dot.
  Set<String> get normalizedExtensions;
/// MIME types normalised to lower case, wildcards excluded.
  List<String> get normalizedMimeTypes;
/// MIME type prefixes such as `image/`, lower case.
  List<String> get mimeTypePrefixes;
/// Whether no limit and no type filter is configured, so a component can skip
/// rendering the constraints help line.
  bool get isUnbounded;
}

enum FileUploadItemsLayout { list, grid }
/// Renders the file rows: a list, a grid or caller-keyed groups.

class FileUploadItemsView extends StatelessWidget {

  List<FileItem> items;

  FileUploadItemsLayout layout;

  int columns;

  String Function(FileItem item)? groupKey;

  FileUploadIconBuilder? iconBuilder;

  ValueChanged<FileItem>? onRetry;

  FileUploadRowTheme? theme;
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}
/// Styling of a [FileUploadRow].
class FileUploadRowTheme extends ComponentThemeData implements Mergeable<FileUploadRowTheme> {

  FileUploadRowTheme merge(FileUploadRowTheme? fallback);
  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;
}

/// rounds into the next unit.

const double kGooeyBlurRatio = 0.5;
///
/// Expansion is driven by hover/press, by a tap on the pill and — when
/// [expandDelay] / [collapseDelay] are set — by an autopilot timer. The
/// component owns the queue and supplies resolved content, styles and colours.
class GooeySurface extends StatefulWidget {
/// Creates a gooey surface.
  const GooeySurface({super.key, required this.title, required this.titleStyle, required this.morphKey, required this.leading, this.description, this.descriptionStyle, this.body, this.action, this.expandable = true, this.width = 350, this.fill = const ThemedColor.ref(ColorRef.popover), this.fillAlpha = 1, this.roundness = 18, this.compactAlignment = Alignment.centerLeft, this.expandUp = false, this.enableGooeyBlur = true, this.surfaceBlur = 0, this.openDuration = const Duration(milliseconds: 600), this.openCurve = Curves.easeInOutCubic, this.bodyAnimation = GooeySurfaceBodyAnimation.fade, this.expandDelay, this.collapseDelay, this.pauseOnHover = true, this.shadows = const <BoxShadow>[], this.contentKey, this.compactMorph = const GooeyCompactMorph(), this.onInteractionChanged, this.onExpansionChanged});
  String title;
  TextStyle titleStyle;
/// Identity of the compact content, so title/state changes morph.
  Object morphKey;
/// Leading widget (state icon).
  Widget? leading;
  String? description;
  TextStyle? descriptionStyle;
  Widget? body;
  Widget? action;
/// Whether the body may expand; `false` keeps the pill shut.
  bool expandable;
  double width;
/// Surface fill; resolves per build, so a preset switch restyles it.
  ThemedColor fill;
/// Whole-surface opacity.
  double fillAlpha;
  double roundness;
/// Horizontal alignment of the compact pill.
  Alignment compactAlignment;
/// Whether the body grows upwards instead of downwards.
  bool expandUp;
/// Whether the metaball blur pass runs.
  bool enableGooeyBlur;
/// Backdrop blur sigma clipped to the silhouette.
  double surfaceBlur;
/// Open/close animation duration.
  Duration openDuration;
/// Open/close animation curve.
  Curve openCurve;
/// Body content animation profile.
  GooeySurfaceBodyAnimation bodyAnimation;
/// Delay before the autopilot expands the body; `null` disables it.
  Duration? expandDelay;
/// Delay before the autopilot collapses the body; `null` disables it.
  Duration? collapseDelay;
/// Whether hover/press pauses an enclosing toast countdown.
  bool pauseOnHover;
/// Token shadows under the silhouette (first layer's colour); empty: none.
  List<BoxShadow> shadows;
/// Identity of the current content for change detection.
///
/// `body`/`action` widgets are rebuilt by callers on every build, so
/// comparing them by identity reschedules the autopilot on no-op rebuilds
/// (pushing collapse later, or re-expanding after a collapse). When either
/// side sets a key, only the key plus the stable fields below drive
/// rescheduling; otherwise the legacy widget-identity comparison applies.
  Object? contentKey;
/// Compact morph profile for in-place title/state changes.
  GooeyCompactMorph compactMorph;
/// Called when hover/press starts or stops, for the pause policy.
  ValueChanged<bool>? onInteractionChanged;
/// Called with `true` when the surface starts opening, `false` when closed.
  ValueChanged<bool>? onExpansionChanged;
  State<GooeySurface> createState();
}
/// Distance from the window edge a gooey toast anchors at.
const double kGooeyEdgeInset = 16;
/// Distance between two toasts stacked in one region.
const double kGooeyStackGap = 8;
/// Resolved screen anchors of one gooey toast.
///
/// Exactly one horizontal (left/right) and one vertical (top/bottom) anchor is
/// set; the other of each pair is null so the toast keeps its intrinsic size on
/// that axis.
class GooeyEdgeAnchors {
/// Creates anchors.
  const GooeyEdgeAnchors({this.left, this.right, this.top, this.bottom});
/// Anchors for [placement] inside [viewport].
///
/// `leading`/`trailing` resolve through [textDirection] so an RTL layout
/// mirrors the horizontal anchor. A horizontally centred toast spans the full
/// width and is centred by its child's alignment, never by a left inset.
  factory GooeyEdgeAnchors.resolve({required ToastPlacement placement, required double width, required Size viewport, required TextDirection textDirection, double inset = kGooeyEdgeInset});
/// Left inset, or null when the toast anchors right.
  double? left;
/// Right inset, or null when the toast anchors left or centre.
  double? right;
/// Top inset, or null when the toast anchors to the bottom.
  double? top;
/// Bottom inset, or null when the toast anchors to the top.
  double? bottom;
}
/// Offsets one region's toasts away from their shared edge.
///
/// The newest toast (index 0) sits nearest the edge; every older one is pushed
/// [gap] further away. [overlapOffset] replaces the gap when the region asks
/// for overlap stacking, and [maxVisible] hides the tail of the stack
/// (`0` keeps everything).
class GooeyStackLayout {
/// Creates a layout.
  const GooeyStackLayout({this.gap = kGooeyStackGap, this.overlapOffset, this.maxVisible = 0});
/// Distance between stacked toasts.
  double gap;
/// Per-item offset used instead of [gap] when overlap stacking is on.
  double? overlapOffset;
/// Maximum visible entries; `0` keeps all of them.
  int maxVisible;
/// Whether the entry at [index] is visible.
  bool isVisible(int index);
/// Offset of the entry at [index] from the region edge.
  double offsetAt(int index);
}
/// Places one gooey toast inside an [Overlay]'s stack at [anchors].
///
/// [offset] is the distance pushed away from the shared edge; it animates, so a
/// toast leaving the region slides the remaining ones into place instead of
/// jumping.
class GooeyAnchoredEntry extends StatelessWidget {
/// Creates an anchored entry.
  const GooeyAnchoredEntry({super.key, required this.anchors, required this.offset, this.duration = const Duration(milliseconds: 220), required this.child});
/// Resolved anchors of this toast.
  GooeyEdgeAnchors anchors;
/// Distance pushed away from the region edge.
  double offset;
/// Reflow duration of the stack offset.
  Duration duration;
/// Toast content.
  Widget child;
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}

/// Timing and choreography of the compact pill morph.
///
/// Changing a toast's title/state in place (the promise and multi-state flows)
/// cross-fades the outgoing compact frame out and the incoming one in instead
/// of snapping: the old label slides up while the new one rises from below, and
/// both scale from [scaleFrom] up to `1`.
class GooeyCompactMorph {
/// Creates a morph profile.
  const GooeyCompactMorph({this.duration = const Duration(milliseconds: 400), this.curve = Curves.easeInOutCubicEmphasized, this.slideOffset = const Offset(0, 0.10), this.scaleFrom = 0.80});
/// Duration of the morph.
  Duration duration;
/// Curve of the morph.
  Curve curve;
/// Slide delta in normalized axis units; `dy` scales with the pill height.
  Offset slideOffset;
/// Starting scale of both frames.
  double scaleFrom;
}
/// The outgoing compact frame while a morph runs.
///
/// [progress] is the eased morph position: `0` fully on the previous frame,
/// `1` settled on the current one. A progress of `1` (the default) means no
/// morph is running and only the current frame paints.
class GooeyCompactMorphFrame {
/// Creates a morph frame.
  const GooeyCompactMorphFrame({this.progress = 1, this.title, this.titleStyle, this.leading});
/// Eased morph position, `0..1`.
  double progress;
/// Outgoing compact title, or null when no morph runs.
  String? title;
/// Outgoing compact title style, tone already applied.
  TextStyle? titleStyle;
/// Outgoing leading widget (state icon).
  Widget? leading;
}
/// Compact pill content: leading icon and title, cross-faded while morphing.

class GooeySurfacePill extends StatelessWidget {

/// Measures the pill width needed to fit [title] and a 24px leading icon.
  static double measureWidth({required String title, required TextStyle style, required TextDirection direction, required double pillHeight, required double maxWidth, double extra = 10});
/// Compact label.
  String title;
/// Compact label style, tone already applied.
  TextStyle titleStyle;
/// Pill width.
  double width;
/// Pill height.
  double height;
/// Current morph frame.
  GooeyCompactMorphFrame morph;
/// Slide of both frames in normalized axis units; `dy` scales with [height].
  Offset morphSlide;
/// Starting scale of both frames.
  double morphScaleFrom;
/// Leading widget (state icon).
  Widget? leading;
/// Whether the body grows upwards, flipping the morph slide.
  bool expandUp;

  VoidCallback? onTap;
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}

/// Reports its child's laid-out size after each layout pass.
class GooeyMeasure extends SingleChildRenderObjectWidget {
/// Creates a measure widget.
  const GooeyMeasure({super.key, required this.onSizeChanged, required super.child});
/// Called with the new size when it changes between layout passes.

/// Overlap of the body rect across the pill seam, so the contour never folds

/// Silhouette of one gooey surface for a single animation frame.

/// Elevation of the token-driven drop shadow under the silhouette.
///
/// `Canvas.drawShadow` cannot represent the token `BoxShadow` offset/spread
/// atoms, so only the token shadow colour is used (resolved by the caller from
/// the shadow scale); the geometry stays a fixed material-style elevation.
const double kGooeyShadowElevation = 4;
/// Paints the single-contour gooey silhouette: an optional token-coloured
/// drop shadow, the opaque fill, and an optional 1px token border.
///
/// The border is stroked once around the merged contour — never per shape —
/// so it cannot double up at the pill/body junction. The open morph is
/// carried by the geometry (width/fillets/height), not by fading shapes.
class GooeyShapePainter extends CustomPainter {
/// Creates a painter for [geometry] in [color].
  const GooeyShapePainter({required this.color, required this.geometry, this.borderColor, this.shadowColor, this.elevation = kGooeyShadowElevation});
/// Opaque surface colour; per-frame alpha is carried by the layer.
  Color color;
/// Silhouette to paint.
  GooeyShapeGeometry geometry;
/// Border colour stroked once around the merged silhouette; null skips it.
  Color? borderColor;
/// Drop shadow colour under the merged silhouette; null skips it.
  Color? shadowColor;
/// Material-style elevation of the drop shadow.
  double elevation;
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size);
  bool shouldRepaint(GooeyShapePainter oldDelegate);
}
/// One gooey surface layer: optional backdrop blur behind the composited
/// shape layers.
class GooeyShapeLayer extends StatelessWidget {
/// Creates a shape layer.
  const GooeyShapeLayer({super.key, required this.width, required this.height, required this.geometry, required this.color, this.fillAlpha = 1, this.blur = 0, this.surfaceBlur = 0, this.enableGooeyBlur = true, this.borderColor, this.shadowColor});
/// Canvas width.
  double width;
/// Canvas height.
  double height;
/// Silhouette geometry for the current animation frame.
  GooeyShapeGeometry geometry;
/// Opaque surface colour.
  Color color;
/// Whole-layer opacity; `1` paints fully opaque.
  double fillAlpha;
/// Blur sigma of the metaball pass; `0` skips it.
  double blur;
/// Backdrop blur sigma clipped to the silhouette; `0` skips it.
  double surfaceBlur;
/// Whether the metaball pass runs at all.
  bool enableGooeyBlur;
/// Border colour around the silhouette; null skips the border.
  Color? borderColor;
/// Drop shadow colour under the silhouette; null skips the shadow.
  Color? shadowColor;
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}
/// The layout/interaction half of one navigation item.
///
/// The caller resolves the theme slices (`background`, `foreground`, ...) and
/// passes plain values, so this file never reads a component theme.
class NavigationItemRow extends StatefulWidget {
/// Creates a navigation row.
  const NavigationItemRow({super.key, required this.child, this.label, this.selected = false, this.enabled = true, this.showLabel = false, this.position = NavigationLabelPosition.bottom, this.spacing = 8, this.labelStyle, this.overflow = TextOverflow.clip, this.wrapLabel, this.background, this.foreground, this.borderColor, this.borderWidth = 1, this.padding, this.minHeight, this.textStyle, this.onPressed, this.focusNode, this.registryValue});
/// Main content (usually an icon).
  Widget child;
/// Optional label.
  Widget? label;
/// Whether the row is the current selection.
  bool selected;
/// Whether the row accepts input.
  bool enabled;
/// Whether the label is expanded; it collapses with an animation otherwise.
  bool showLabel;
/// Label position relative to [child].
  NavigationLabelPosition position;
/// Space between the icon and the label.
  double spacing;
/// Label text style; its colour is taken from [foreground].
  TextStyle? labelStyle;
/// Label text overflow when no [wrapLabel] handles it.
  TextOverflow overflow;
/// Extra wrapper for the label (marquee, tooltip); null uses [overflow].
  Widget Function(Widget label)? wrapLabel;
/// Per-state fill.
  StateValue<ThemedColor>? background;
/// Per-state foreground for the content and label.
  StateValue<ThemedColor>? foreground;
/// Per-state border; null draws none.
  StateValue<ThemedColor>? borderColor;
/// Border width used when [borderColor] resolves non-null.
  double borderWidth;
/// Row padding; null resolves `navigationItemDefaultPadding` (12x8).
  EdgeInsetsGeometry? padding;
/// Content box minimum height; null adds none.
  double? minHeight;
/// Text style before the foreground colour is applied.
  TextStyle? textStyle;
/// Called when the row is pressed.
  VoidCallback? onPressed;
/// Focus node; one is created and disposed when null.
  FocusNode? focusNode;
/// Value registered with the nearest `RovingGroupRegistry<int>`; null skips
/// registration.
  int? registryValue;
  State<NavigationItemRow> createState();
}
/// Which navigation container to render.
enum NavigationContainerType { bar, rail, sidebar }
/// When navigation labels are shown.
enum NavigationLabelType { none, selected, all, tooltip, expanded }
/// Label text size.
enum NavigationLabelSize { small, large }

enum NavigationOverflow { clip, marquee, ellipsis, none }

/// One navigation item state's styling slice.
///
/// Every field is nullable: an override leg sets only what it changes and
/// [merge] keeps the lower leg's remaining fields.
class NavigationItemStyle implements Mergeable<NavigationItemStyle> {
/// Creates a navigation item style.
  const NavigationItemStyle({this.background, this.foreground, this.borderColor, this.borderWidth, this.padding, this.minHeight, this.textStyle});
/// Per-state fill.
  StateValue<ThemedColor>? background;
/// Per-state content/label colour.
  StateValue<ThemedColor>? foreground;
/// Per-state border; null draws none.
  StateValue<ThemedColor>? borderColor;
/// Border width used when [borderColor] resolves non-null.
  double? borderWidth;
/// Row padding; null falls back to the row default.
  EdgeInsetsGeometry? padding;
/// Content box minimum height; null falls back to 20 (h-9 with the default
/// padding). Keeps rows 36 high even while the label is collapsed.
  double? minHeight;
/// Label style; its colour is ignored (taken from [foreground]).
  TextStyle? textStyle;
/// First-non-null-wins merge; the receiver (higher-priority leg) wins.
  NavigationItemStyle merge(NavigationItemStyle? fallback);
  bool operator ==(Object other);
  int get hashCode;
}

const NavigationItemStyle navigationActiveItemDefaults = NavigationItemStyle(background: StateValue(rest: ThemedColor.ref(ColorRef.secondary), hovered: ThemedColor.ref(ColorRef.secondary, alpha: 0.8), pressed: ThemedColor.ref(ColorRef.secondary, alpha: 0.8)), foreground: StateValue(rest: ThemedColor.ref(ColorRef.secondaryForeground)), padding: navigationItemDefaultPadding, minHeight: 20, textStyle: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500));

/// How one column or row is sized inside a table.

  const TableSize();
}

/// A pinned row or column range.

  Iterable<TableRef> frozenColumns;

  bool columnHover;

  bool rowHover;

  bool selected;

  bool enabled;
/// Per-state fill.
  StateValue<ThemedColor>? background;
/// Per-state text colour.
  StateValue<ThemedColor>? foreground;
/// Per-state bottom-border colour.
  StateValue<ThemedColor>? borderColor;
/// Bottom-border width.
  double? borderWidth;
/// Text style override (colour comes from [foreground]).
  TextStyle? textStyle;
/// Inner padding.
  EdgeInsetsGeometry? padding;
/// Minimum cell height.
  double? minHeight;
  Widget build(BuildContext context);
}
